items.title: US threatens to block arms for Ukraine over refinery attacks, FT reports
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: The US is threatening to stop the procurement system that provides Ukraine with weapons in order to press Kyiv to halt its deep strikes on Russian energy infrastructure, the Financial Times reported on Sunday, citing officials in Europe.
items.body:
The US is threatening to stop the procurement system that provides Ukraine with weapons in order to press Kyiv to halt its deep strikes on Russian energy infrastructure, the Financial Times reported on Sunday, citing officials in Europe .
The officials, who received calls from US officials or were briefed on them, said that the US was lobbying European capitals and Kyiv to try to end the attacks on Russian oil refineries, the report added.
Reuters could not immediately verify the report. The White House did not immediately respond to a request for comment.
The message from the US included threats to cut off intelligence sharing and Purl (the Prioritised Ukraine Requirements List) mechanism for procuring US weapons for Ukraine, the report added.
"They are calling Kyiv . ... They are calling everyone [in Europe]," said an official who received a call from a US defence official, as per the report.
The report comes after US President Donald Trump made a surprise announcement on Sunday of an energy ceasefire between Russia and Ukraine that he said was "effective immediately," but Ukrainian leader Volodymyr Zelenskiy said he was still waiting to see details of the deal.
"Effective immediately, there is an ENERGY CEASEFIRE in the War between Russia and Ukraine . Both parties have agreed. Do not break it!" Trump wrote.

items.title: Vikings TE T.J. Hockenson (concussion) out vs. Saints
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Minnesota Vikings tight end T.J. Hockenson suffered a concussion on the opening possession and was ruled out for the rest of Sunday's game against the host New Orleans Saints.
items.body:
Minnesota Vikings tight end T.J. Hockenson suffered a concussion on the opening possession and was ruled out for the rest of Sunday's game against the host New Orleans Saints.
Hockenson led Minnesota with 22 receptions through four games after catching 13 passes in a 15-10 victory against Miami last week.
He caught a 7-yard pass from Kyler Murray on the second play on Sunday and was injured while being tackled by Pete Werner. He went to the locker room for evaluation and was ruled out shortly thereafter.
The Vikings' possession ended with a 40-yard field goal by Will Reichard.
--Field Level Media

items.title: India hold off West Indies to take 2-1 series lead in third T20
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: India beat West Indies by 14 runs on Sunday in Indore to take a 2-1 lead in the five-match Twenty20 International series.
items.body:
India beat West Indies by 14 runs on Sunday in Indore to take a 2-1 lead in the five-match Twenty20 International series.
Chasing 224 for victory, West Indies suffered an early setback when Arshdeep Singh dismissed captain Shai Hope for five after he missed a swipe at a delivery that jagged back on to his stumps.
Shimron Hetmyer kept the visitors in the hunt with a brisk 43 off 26 balls before spinner Naman Dhir broke the stand, while Axar Patel removed Rovman Powell to leave West Indies struggling to match the mounting required rate.
Quentin Sampson and Sherfane Rutherford briefly revived the chase, but West Indies could not sustain the momentum as wickets fell regularly in the closing overs and they finished on 209-7.
Arshdeep was India's standout bowler with 3-44 as the hosts defended a formidable 223 after being asked to bat.
India recovered from the early loss of Sanju Samson, who fell for just three to Shamar Joseph, through a 108-run partnership for the second wicket between Abhishek Sharma and Ishan Kishan.
Sharma dominated the scoring with an explosive 69 off 30 balls, while Kishan contributed 37. However, the hosts lost momentum when Kishan's dismissal triggered a middle-order collapse.
The platform laid by Sharma ultimately proved decisive, allowing the lower order to keep the scoreboard moving and lift India to 223 before they were bowled out off the final delivery of the innings.
The teams meet again in the fourth Twenty20 International in Hyderabad on Wednesday.

items.title: L'Iran dit que la réponse des USA à sa proposition de rouvrir Ormuz était "insuffisante"
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: La réponse des États-Unis aux conditions posées par l'Iran dans le cadre d'une proposition visant à rouvrir le détroit d'Ormuz a été jugée "insuffisante", a déclaré dimanche le chef de la sécurité iranienne, Mohsen Rezaei, cité par les médias d'État.
items.body:
La réponse des États-Unis aux conditions posées par l'Iran dans le cadre d'une proposition visant à rouvrir le détroit d'Ormuz a été jugée "insuffisante", a déclaré dimanche le chef de la sécurité iranienne, Mohsen Rezaei, cité par les médias d'État.
Selon cette proposition, présentée par Téhéran début octobre lors de l'Assemblée générale des Nations unies, le détroit d'Ormuz pourrait être rouvert et la circulation maritime y serait rétablie dans un délai de sept jours si les conditions étaient remplies. Les États-Unis y ont ensuite répondu par l'intermédiaire du Qatar.
Washington doit clarifier les points qui restent flous pour Téhéran, a déclaré Mohsen Rezaei, secrétaire du Conseil suprême de sécurité nationale, ajoutant : "Nous avons présenté sept conditions aux Américains et clairement indiqué que le détroit d'Ormuz ne leur serait pas ouvert et qu'aucun accord n'aurait lieu tant que ces conditions ne seraient pas remplies."
La Maison blanche n'a pas répondu dans l'immédiat à une demande de commentaires.
Selon Mohsen Rezaei, l'Iran "n'est plus dans un processus de réponse aux Américains". "Ils ont accepté certaines de nos conditions, tandis que d'autres restent floues", a-t-il ajouté.
Téhéran a indiqué fin septembre avoir reçu une réponse américaine à sa dernière proposition visant à rétablir le cessez-le-feu dans le Golfe, quelques jours après que le président américain Donald Trump eut déclaré l'avoir rejetée.
Le Qatar et d'autres médiateurs ont relayé des messages entre Washington et Téhéran dans le but de mettre fin au conflit et de rouvrir le détroit d'Ormuz, par lequel transitait un cinquième du pétrole et du gaz naturel liquéfié mondiaux avant la guerre, déclenchée fin février par des attaques américaines et israéliennes contre l'Iran.

items.title: Trump anuncia cessar-fogo energético entre Ucrânia e Rússia e surpreende Zelenskiy
items.author: Daniel Flynn, Steve Holland
items.creator: Daniel Flynn, Steve Holland
items.summary: O presidente dos EUA, Donald Trump, fez um anúncio surpresa no domingo sobre um cessar-fogo no setor energético entre a Rússia e a Ucrânia, que, segundo ele, entrará em vigor imediatamente, mas o líder ucraniano Volodymyr Zelenskiy afirmou que ainda estava aguardando os detalhes do acordo.
items.body:
O presidente dos EUA, Donald Trump, fez um anúncio surpresa no domingo sobre um cessar-fogo no setor energético entre a Rússia e a Ucrânia, que, segundo ele, entrará em vigor imediatamente, mas o líder ucraniano Volodymyr Zelenskiy afirmou que ainda estava aguardando os detalhes do acordo.
Não houve reação de Moscou ao anúncio, que ocorreu após dias de intensa pressão de Trump para que a Ucrânia suspendesse seus ataques a refinarias de petróleo russas. Ele atribui a esses ataques o aumento nos preços do diesel que está prejudicando seu Partido Republicano às vésperas das eleições de meio de mandato nos EUA no próximo mês.
Em uma dramática deterioração das relações, Trump advertiu Zelenskiy no sábado que ele deveria “parar de uma vez por todas” de atacar as refinarias russas e instou os ucranianos a substituírem seu líder em novas eleições. Trump afirmou que Zelenskiy havia perdido várias oportunidades de chegar a um acordo com Moscou.
Em uma postagem na sua plataforma Truth Social no domingo, Trump anunciou inesperadamente que Ucrânia e Rússia haviam concordado com um cessar-fogo energético, mas não deu mais detalhes.
“Com efeito imediato, há um CESSAR-FOGO ENERGÉTICO na guerra entre a Rússia e a Ucrânia. Ambas as partes concordaram. Não o quebrem!”, escreveu Trump.
Trump, cuja guerra no Irã tem sido amplamente responsabilizada pelo aumento dos preços globais dos combustíveis, já havia anunciado um cessar-fogo energético na Ucrânia em meados de setembro, embora nenhum dos lados tenha confirmado que tal acordo tivesse sido alcançado.
Zelenskiy disse em uma postagem no aplicativo Telegram que discutiu o anúncio de Trump com o secretário-geral da Otan, Mark Rutte, o primeiro-ministro canadense, Mark Carney, e o presidente finlandês, Alexander Stubb.
“A Ucrânia apoia o cessar-fogo, e é importante que a Rússia também o apoie. Estamos aguardando detalhes do lado americano”, declarou ele.
Horas antes, Zelenskiy havia resistido à pressão dos EUA para que houvesse um fim unilateral aos ataques ucranianos às refinarias russas, repetindo sua posição de longa data de que só estaria disposto a fazê-lo se o presidente Vladimir Putin suspendesse os ataques russos à infraestrutura energética ucraniana.
Qualquer acordo de cessar-fogo desse tipo precisaria vir acompanhado de “garantias reais”, disse Zelenskiy.
“A verdadeira causa da guerra na Europa é a Rússia e somente a Rússia”, afirmou Zelenskiy. “É possível interromper os ataques à infraestrutura energética já hoje, mas Putin não quer fazer isso.”
PROMESSA DE ELEIÇÕES Trump também pediu a realização de eleições na Ucrânia, suspensas desde a invasão russa de 2022, ao que Zelenskiy respondeu que convocaria uma votação caso Putin concordasse com um cessar-fogo de 60 dias.
Zelenskiy disse que cabia “aos ucranianos” escolher seu líder, mas acrescentou que, primeiro, era preciso que houvesse um fim aos combates. A lei ucraniana proíbe a realização de eleições sob lei marcial por motivos de segurança.
“Por favor, diga a Putin: dê-nos dois meses, 60 dias de cessar-fogo total, 60 dias, e nós organizaremos eleições”, declarou Zelenskiy.
O líder ucraniano negou ser o responsável pelos aumentos nos preços da energia, acrescentando que “todo mundo” sabe que a guerra no Oriente Médio é um fator mais importante.
O forte aumento nos preços globais do diesel, que se seguiu ao início da guerra no Irã em fevereiro, tornou-se um problema político para o Partido Republicano de Trump às vésperas das eleições de meio de mandato, quando os democratas da oposição podem conquistar o controle de uma ou ambas as casas do Congresso.
No sábado, Zelenskiy reagiu com indignação ao anúncio de Trump sobre um acordo de fornecimento de diesel com a Rússia, afirmando que isso encorajaria os ataques de Moscou à Ucrânia e levaria a uma perda ainda maior de vidas civis.
Analistas afirmaram que é improvável que o acordo de fornecimento de diesel de Trump com Moscou leve a uma redução sustentada nos preços dos combustíveis, já que os volumes envolvidos são muito pequenos.

items.title: Mexico's Sheinbaum urges coastal residents to remain indoors as Hurricane Simon nears coast
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: The NHC warned that heavy rainfall could trigger life-threatening flooding and mudslides.
items.body:
Mexican President Claudia Sheinbaum urged residents along the country's Pacific coast to remain indoors on Sunday as powerful Category 4 Hurricane Simon approached Mexico's west-central coast, threatening destructive winds, dangerous storm surges and potentially deadly flooding.
Simon was located about 65 miles (105 km) west-northwest of the port city of Manzanillo, in Colima state, with maximum sustained winds of 145 mph (230 kph), the US National Hurricane Center (NHC) said in its latest advisory at 9 a.m. local time.
The hurricane was moving north-northwest at 11 kph (7 mph), with its center about 140 km (85 miles) south-southeast of Cabo Corrientes, in neighboring Jalisco state.
"With the approaching impact of Category 4 Hurricane Simon, we urge residents of coastal municipalities in Jalisco, Colima, Nayarit and Michoacan to remain sheltered until authorities officially declare that the danger has passed," Sheinbaum said in a post on X.
She said precautionary evacuations to safer areas were continuing and urged residents to stay off the streets and follow civil protection instructions.
The NHC said Simon was expected to move very near Mexico's west-central coast later on Sunday and remain close to the coast on Monday, although forecast uncertainty remained over whether the center would cross inland or remain just offshore.
Even without a direct landfall, dangerous storm surges, large destructive waves and damaging winds were likely along portions of Mexico's west-central coast, the forecaster warned.
Mexico's National Civil Protection Coordination (CNPC) placed 28 municipalities in Jalisco and Colima under its highest cyclone alert level, while another 93 municipalities were under a high alert level, according to civil protection bulletins.
Puerto Vallarta's international airport has temporarily closed, while authorities have suspended nonessential activities and opened emergency shelters in threatened coastal communities.
The NHC warned that heavy rainfall through Monday could trigger life-threatening flooding and mudslides, particularly in mountainous areas.
Simon intensified rapidly into a Category 4 hurricane on Saturday, prompting authorities to deploy military personnel, emergency workers and civil protection teams to vulnerable coastal communities.
The storm comes a week after Hurricane Polo struck Mexico's Baja California Peninsula as a Category 2 hurricane, toppling trees and utility poles and flooding streets.

items.title: 'Windows of Opportunity' to End War in Ukraine, SACEUR Says
items.summary: NATO Supreme Allied Commander Europe (SACEUR) General Alexus G. Grynkewich - the alliance's top military commander - says the alliance should increase support to Ukraine when they're hit by Russian hybrid attacks. On the "brutal" war, he said there are "windows of opportunity" to bring the conflict to an end and that the alliance should seize them where possible to bring both sides to the table. He made the comments in his first interview with Bloomberg TV's Oliver Crook in Warsaw on Sunday Oct. 11. (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: Ten-man Freiburg bag late winner against Schalke to go top of the Bundesliga
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Ten-man Freiburg scored an 85th-minute winner through Keisuke Goto to snatch a 2-1 victory over visitors Schalke 04 on Sunday and move top of the Bundesliga.
items.body:
Ten-man Freiburg scored an 85th-minute winner through Keisuke Goto to snatch a 2-1 victory over visitors Schalke 04 on Sunday and move top of the Bundesliga.
Freiburg, who had already made a club-record start with 10 points from their opening four matches, climbed to 13 points, ahead of Borussia Dortmund on goal difference. Champions Bayern, who [USN:L6N45W03O TEXT:"drew"] 2-2 against Augsburg on Saturday, are third on 11.
With Freiburg in control, Maximilian Eggestein put the hosts in front after 10 minutes, but Schalke hit back through Adrian Gantenbein on the half-hour.
Freiburg were reduced to 10 men when Yuito Suzuki received a second yellow card in the 64th minute, seemingly handing Schalke the initiative.
But the visitors were far too passive and toothless in attack to make the extra man count and Freiburg punished them five minutes before the end with Japan international Goto snatching the winner with a glancing header.

WASHINGTON: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said on Sunday (Oct 11) in response to critical comments from US President Donald Trump that he will organise elections in Ukraine if Russian President Vladimir Putin agrees to a 60-day ceasefire.
"Please tell Putin, give us two months, 60 days of total ceasefire, 60 days, and we will organise elections," Zelenskyy told ABC's "This Week."
Trump on Saturday criticised Zelenskyy for attacking Russian oil refineries a day after the US temporarily lifted sanctions on Russian fuel that were designed to deprive Moscow of revenues to fund its war in Ukraine.
"I think it's time for Ukraine to get a new president," Trump had told reporters at the White House.

In response, Zelenskyy said "it's up to Ukrainians" to choose their leader and noted that Putin would also like to change who is leading Ukraine.
He said it is easy for Ukraine to be blamed for higher fuel prices "when everybody in the world understands because of the war in (the) Middle East, the prices are rising."

Related:

Trump says Russia and Ukraine agree to 'energy ceasefire'

Russia's Yandex says data centre in Vladimir area shut down after drone attack

Trump says Putin agrees to major release of diesel to US, global markets

Earlier on Sunday, Zelenskyy said Ukraine was ready to halt attacks on Russian oil refineries if Moscow ceases its own strikes on Ukrainian energy infrastructure.
Under terms of the deal as described by Trump on Friday, Russia will immediately supply more than 300,000 metric tons of diesel to US and global markets, equal to about 2.25 million barrels of fuel. The US exports about 1.5 million barrels of diesel per day.
Trump is under pressure to bring down rising fuel prices ahead of November midterm elections that will determine whether his Republican Party will retain control of the US Congress for his final two years in office.
Many lawmakers, including Republicans, have criticised the diesel deal as rewarding Putin.

Source: Reuters/fs

items.title: Cam Little drills 57-yard field goal as Jags jolt Eagles in London
items.author: Field Level Media
items.creator: Field Level Media
items.summary: Cam Little made the second of two field goals in the final eight seconds, giving the Jacksonville Jaguars a dramatic 19-17 win over the Philadelphia Eagles on Sunday in London.
items.body:
Cam Little made the second of two field goals in the final eight seconds, giving the Jacksonville Jaguars a dramatic 19-17 win over the Philadelphia Eagles on Sunday in London.
After Jake Elliott's 48-yard field goal handed Philadelphia a 17-16 lead with eight seconds left, Jacksonville's Ameer Abdullah returned the ensuing kickoff 53 yards to the Eagles 39 before he was tackled with one second left.
Little drilled a 57-yard field goal to run the Jaguars' winning streak to three games. He had previously missed an extra point behind a high snap from backup long snapper DaVon Hamilton after Parker Washington's 27-yard touchdown catch gave Jacksonville a 16-14 lead with 3:20 left.
Elliott's field goal provided the Eagles' first second-half points since Week 2 against the Tennessee Titans on Sept. 20. It couldn't prevent Philadelphia's losing streak from reaching three games, however.
Washington finished with six catches for 124 yards and two touchdowns from Trevor Lawrence, who completed 24 of 39 passes for 331 yards, two touchdowns and one interception. Jacksonville (4-1) overcame 13 penalties for 100 yards by outgaining the Eagles 408-232. Tight end Brenton Strange added seven catches for 68 yards.
Jalen Hurts completed 21 of 40 passes for 220 yards and one touchdown for Philadelphia (2-3). Darius Cooper caught two passes for 71 yards and a touchdown.
The Eagles, who entered the game without top two running backs Saquon Barkley and Tank Bigsby, lost third-string Will Shipley during the game. He finished with 22 rushing yards.
Trailing 14-7 at halftime, Jacksonville cut into the lead with Little's 34-yard field goal on its first possession of the second half.
Jacksonville then squandered a prime chance to take the lead midway through the fourth quarter when a trio of procedural penalties spoiled a first-and-goal at the 1, leading to a turnover on downs.
The Jaguars appeared to take the lead on the opening kickoff, which Josh Cameron returned 90 yards for a score before it was negated by a holding penalty.
Jacksonville did open the scoring later in the first quarter, when Lawrence hit Washington for a 51-yard catch-and-run touchdown with 5:26 left.
The Eagles, though, jumped ahead 14-7 behind a pair of second-quarter touchdowns. Shipley tied the game with a 2-yard TD run. Cooper gave Philadelphia the lead with 5:31 left before halftime on a 62-yard touchdown catch by Cooper, his fourth TD on six catches this season at that point.
The Eagles defense then came up with a goal-line stand at the end of the first half, with Zach Baun making a diving tackle on Tuten when Jacksonville elected to go on fourth-and-goal with one second left.

LIVERPOOL, Oct 11 : Manchester City silenced a hostile Anfield crowd as second-half goals from Erling Haaland, Jeremy Doku and Rayan Cherki secured a 3-0 victory over 10-man Liverpool on Sunday and maintained the Premier League leaders' perfect start to the season.
City were playing for the first time since an independent commission found them guilty of 114 breaches of the league's financial rules, and were greeted by deafening boos and angry chants.
But Enzo Maresca's side stood firm against Liverpool's early pressure and a fevered atmosphere before taking control after Ryan Gravenberch was sent off in the 62nd minute for a second booking following a foul on Doku.
HAALAND SPARKS CITY ROUT

Haaland then struck three minutes later, smashing a left-footed shot past Alisson after Doku worked the ball into the box and his attempted shot was deflected into the path of the big Norwegian.
Haaland made a beeline to celebrate with the travelling City fans including Oasis frontman Noel Gallagher.
Doku doubled the lead in the 68th minute with a gorgeous long-range shot that curled into the far top corner. Cherki completed the rout - and sent scores of Liverpool fans heading to the exits - in the 78th minute when he let the ball roll through to Josko Gvardiol before turning into the box to meet his teammate's pass and slot the ball home.
"It was a lovely moment that will stay with us a long time," Man City striker Haaland told Sky Sports.
"It’s time to stay strong and stick together and do what you can do something about, stick together."
Man City midfielder Elliot Anderson said City's unity had stood out.
"We've shown real togetherness and fight. It's a tough place to come and it's challenging," he said.
"We really stuck together out there, fought for each other and played well."
The Liverpool fans left at the final whistle chanted "Going down! Going Down! Going Down!" in reference to City's potential relegation. The club have denied all wrongdoing, and have appealed the independent commission's verdict.
CITY DELIVER DEFIANT RESPONSE
A defiant Haaland and Maresca grinned and pumped their fists at the City fans, who delightedly waved inflatable bananas, a tradition dating from their time out of the top flight in the 1980s.
The victory gave City six wins from six and moved them three points clear of Arsenal on 18 points, providing a forceful response on the pitch after a turbulent week away from it. Liverpool are ninth after their first league loss of the season.
Maresca is only the fourth manager to win their first six Premier League matches in charge of a club, after Pep Guardiola (City in 2016), Carlo Ancelotti (Chelsea, 2009) and Ole Gunnar Solskjaer (Manchester United, 2018-19).
City's resounding victory comes with caveats. While they remain firmly in control at the top of the league, their perfect start increasingly stands in contrast to the uncertainty surrounding the club, with the fallout from the financial rules verdict leaving far more questions than answers about what comes next.

Source: Reuters

items.title: GB-Burnham dit que la Russie s'est ingérée dans le référendum sur le Brexit de 2016
items.author: Andrew Macaskill
items.creator: Andrew Macaskill
items.summary: La Russie s'est ingérée dans le référendum sur le Brexit de 2016, a déclaré le Premier ministre britannique Andy Burnham lors d'un entretien diffusé dimanche, en mettant en garde la France et l'Allemagne contre les tentatives soutenues par Moscou visant à influencer leur vie politique.
items.body:
La Russie s'est ingérée dans le référendum sur le Brexit de 2016, a déclaré le Premier ministre britannique Andy Burnham lors d'un entretien diffusé dimanche, en mettant en garde la France et l'Allemagne contre les tentatives soutenues par Moscou visant à influencer leur vie politique.
Andy Burnham, qui est devenu Premier ministre en juillet et a déclaré le mois dernier que le Royaume-Uni pourrait envisager de réintégrer l'Union européenne à l'avenir, est le premier chef du gouvernement britannique à dire ouvertement qu'il existe des preuves d'une ingérence russe lors du référendum sur le Brexit.
"En arrivant à Downing Street, j'ai posé la question suivante : y a-t-il eu ingérence de la Russie lors du référendum de 2016 ? Et j'ai reçu une réponse claire : oui, il y en a eu", a-t-il déclaré lors dans une interview accordée au podcast "The Rest Is Politics".
Andy Burnham n'a pas précisé à quel type d'ingérence Moscou s'est livré et n'a donné aucune précision sur les preuves étayant ses déclarations.
L'ambassade de Russie à Londres n'a pas répondu dans l'immédiat à une demande de commentaire.
Moscou a déjà nié toute ingérence dans le vote sur le Brexit, présentant la Grande-Bretagne comme étant en proie à une hystérie anti-russe.
Les propos tenus par Andy Burnham marquent une rupture avec ceux de l'ancien Premier ministre Boris Johnson, qui avait fait campagne en faveur de la sortie de l'UE et avait déclaré en 2020 qu'il n'y avait aucune preuve d'ingérence russe dans le référendum.
En 2016, les Britanniques ont voté à 52% contre 48% en faveur de la sortie de l'UE, plongeant le pays dans sa plus grave crise politique depuis la Seconde Guerre mondiale.
Andy Burnham a également déclaré que les électeurs des démocraties européennes devaient être mieux informés des tentatives visant à perturber leur vie politique.
"Je veux dire par là qu'il est important aujourd'hui de mettre les choses au clair, et je pense que cela aidera les électeurs allemands et français à comprendre qu'une partie de cette politique est orchestrée par nos ennemis, à savoir la Russie", a-t-il déclaré.
Un rapport publié en 2020 par la Commission parlementaire du renseignement et de la sécurité du Royaume-Uni indiquait que Londres n'avait pas réussi à établir si la Russie s'est ingérée dans le référendum de 2016.
Toujours selon ce rapport, Moscou a cependant tenté d'influencer le référendum sur l'indépendance de l'Écosse de 2014, au cours duquel les électeurs ont rejeté l'indépendance.

items.title: Glucksmann wins centre-left ticket for France's presidential election
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Raphael Glucksmann, an EU lawmaker, won France's centre-left's presidential primary on Sunday, positioning himself as the left's main alternative to hard-left leader Jean-Luc Melenchon.
items.body:
Raphael Glucksmann, an EU lawmaker, won France's centre-left's presidential primary on Sunday, positioning himself as the left's main alternative to hard-left leader Jean-Luc Melenchon.
Glucksmann, 46, who leads the Place Publique movement, won the primary in a first round of voting, securing an outright majority with 66% of the vote.
"I am the candidate who stands for a break with Macronism, the candidate who stands for a break with Jean-Luc Melenchon’s hegemony over the French left, the candidate who can defeat our long-standing enemy – the far right," he told party activists after the vote.
Glucksmann now faces the task of uniting a fractured left in a presidential campaign increasingly shaped by the far right.
More than 120,000 people turned out for the vote, far fewer than in the past - 2.8 million took part in the Socialists’ 2011 primary, won by the eventual president, Francois Hollande.
Glucksmann, who led the mainstream left to secure 14% of French seats in the 2024 European Parliament election, opposes any alliance with Melenchon. Opinion polls show he could make it into a May 2 runoff vote in the presidential election, but would lose to frontrunner Marine Le Pen from the far right.
Glucksmann's victory in the primary vote is a blow for Socialist Party head Olivier Faure, who has been open to alliances with Melenchon's France Unbowed party and won only 14.5% of the vote.
"We shall unite to take up the fight and prevent the Trumpists, the coup plotters, the xenophobes and the demagogues from seizing control of the Republic," Glucksman said.
While critical of some of President Emmanuel Macron's pro-business policies, Glucksmann has advocated a similar pro-European, pro-Ukraine line, positioning himself as a staunch defender of liberal democracy.

items.title: SALON La célèbre 2CV reprend du service ... en électrique
items.author: Gilles Guillaume
items.creator: Gilles Guillaume
items.summary: Stellantis a dévoilé dimanche un concept car très attendu, préfigurant le retour de la 2CV Citroën, une icône dont le groupe a choisi de reprendre de nombreux codes pour se distinguer d'une concurrence toujours plus nombreuse en Europe.
items.body:
Stellantis a dévoilé dimanche un concept car très attendu, préfigurant le retour de la 2CV Citroën, une icône dont le groupe a choisi de reprendre de nombreux codes pour se distinguer d'une concurrence toujours plus nombreuse en Europe.
A la veille d'un Mondial de l'automobile marqué par une [USN:L6N45U145 TEXT:"déferlante"] de plus de vingt marques chinoises, le constructeur automobile franco-italo-américain a choisi de jouer à fond la carte du "revival" pour cette future petite voiture abordable, annoncée à moins de 15.000 euros.
Signe des temps, elle ne sera disponible uniquement qu'en motorisation électrique.
Si d'autres marques ont rencontré le succès en revisitant des silhouettes célèbres de leur histoire - Mini, Fiat 500, Renault 5 et Twingo -, l'exercice était plus audacieux pour un modèle dont le cahier des charges initial, à l'aube de la Seconde guerre mondiale, était frugal et conçu pour une France encore très rurale.
Le projet TPV (Toute petite voiture) consistait à concevoir un véhicule économique, léger et robuste pouvant transporter quatre personnes à travers un champ sans casser un seul oeuf.
"C'était vraiment une prouesse pour aller enlever du coût superflu, de la masse", a déclaré Xavier Chardon, directeur général de la marque aux chevrons, à des journalistes.
"Ce qu'on voulait, c'était retrouver cette alchimie entre la simplicité, donc arrêter le toujours plus. Il n'y a pas de superflu dans cette voiture, mais accessible ne veut pas dire camelote", a-t-il ajouté.
Comme son aînée, produite à plus de cinq millions d'exemplaires en plus de quarante ans d'existence, entre 1948 et 1990, la nouvelle 2CV se veut dépouillée, pratique et très compacte (3,76 mètres de long, plus courte que l'originale).
Elle fait aussi référence pas moins de 15 fois à l'ancien modèle: même si ce n'est pas la plus aérodynamique qui soit, la silhouette ronde immédiatement identifiable a été conservée, tout comme à l'avant les phares détachés de la carrosserie et les ailes protubérantes, grâce à un stratagème des designers.
La 2CV concept arbore aussi un capot strié, un toit ouvrant en toile, des clignotants latéraux, une chute de toit tombant jusqu'au pare-choc arrière, des poignées de portes profilées, des jantes tôle à l'ancienne et des pneus d'aspect vintage signés Michelin, clin d'oeil à une époque où Citroën appartenait au fabricant de pneumatiques.
A l'intérieur, elle propose une banquette à l'avant, un volant monobranche, une instrumentation minimaliste et un poste de radio amovible pouvant servir d'enceinte.
"Il faut qu'on soit fier de notre ADN, on a 107 ans d'histoire, on a des produits iconiques", a poursuivi Xavier Chardon. "Il ne faut pas se leurrer, on a en face de nous de plus en plus de concurrents, qui viennent pour beaucoup de l'Est. Je crois qu'il faut qu'on ait des marqueurs qui soient forts en terme de différenciation."
La voiture inspirée du concept est annoncée pour 2028. Elle sera basée sur la petite plateforme électrique abordable de Stellantis (STLAM.MI) , nommée e-car, dont l'industrialisation est prévue dans l'usine italienne de Pomigliano d'Arco grâce à des partenariats pour réduire les coûts.
Le groupe a déjà dit qu'au moins deux modèles, voire trois, de différentes marques, devraient être basés sur cette nouvelle architecture.

items.title: Raiders RB Ashton Jeanty listed as active vs. Patriots
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Las Vegas Raiders running back Ashton Jeanty is active for Sunday's game against the New England Patriots in Foxborough, Mass.
items.body:
Las Vegas Raiders running back Ashton Jeanty is active for Sunday's game against the New England Patriots in Foxborough, Mass.
Jeanty was questionable for the contest after he sat out Friday's practice with ankle and foot injuries. Multiple media outlets reported Jeanty had a flare-up of plantar fasciitis and an ankle injury he sustained in late August.
Jeanty, 22, has started all four games this season and has rushed 78 times for 264 yards (3.4 yards per carry) and no touchdowns. His longest run has been 19 yards. He also has caught 19 passes for 165 yards and two scores.
Jeanty appeared to hurt his ankle in the third quarter of Sunday's 30-27 loss to the Kansas City Chiefs, but he finished the game.
He had 266 carries for 975 yards and five touchdowns in 17 games (all starts) as a rookie last season. Las Vegas selected Jeanty with the sixth overall pick in the 2025 NFL Draft out of Boise State.
Jeanty's backup is rookie Mike Washington Jr., who has 24 carries for 120 yards and one touchdown in four games. The Raiders selected Washington in the fourth round of the 2026 draft out of Arkansas.
Wide receiver Jalen Nailor, safeties Tristin McCollum and Dalton Johnson, center Trey Zuhn, defensive tackle J.J. Pegues and running back Roman Hemby are inactive for the Raiders (3-1). Aidan O'Connell is the emergency quarterback.
The Patriots (2-2) listed cornerbacks Christian Gonzalez, Carlton Davis, Karon Prunty and Channing Canada as well as offensive tackle Dametrious Crownover as inactive. Behren Morton is the emergency quarterback.
--Field Level Media

items.summary: The Indian embassy in Saudi Arabia said on Sunday that an Indian national injured in the attack at Riyadh's international airport had died.
items.body:
The Indian embassy in Saudi Arabia said on Sunday that an Indian national injured in the attack at Riyadh's international airport had died.
"We are in touch with the family and will provide all support for ensuring the early repatriation of mortal remains," the embassy said in a post on X.
The Indian national's death adds to the death toll from the attack at Riyadh's international airport on Saturday, which [USN:L1N45X01E TEXT:"killed 12 people"] according to initial reports and wounded more than 300 others, the deadliest such strike on Saudi Arabia in over a decade.

items.title: Chefe do Deutsche Bank alerta que resultados de eleições na Alemanha preocupam investidores estrangeiros
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: O chefe do maior banco da Alemanha alertou que os investidores estrangeiros podem ser afastados após as vitórias obtidas nas eleições estaduais do mês passado por partidos de extremos políticos.
items.body:
O chefe do maior banco da Alemanha alertou que os investidores estrangeiros podem ser afastados após as vitórias obtidas nas eleições estaduais do mês passado por partidos de extremos políticos.
A AfD, que pretende restringir a imigração e enviar os requerentes de asilo de volta aos seus países, obteve algumas de suas maiores vitórias de todos os tempos no leste da Alemanha no mês passado. Ao mesmo tempo, o partido Esquerda obteve sua maior vitória na eleição para o governo municipal de Berlim, prometendo expropriar os patrimônios de empresas imobiliárias.
“Isso representa um risco significativo para a Alemanha e não deve ser minimizado”, disse Christian Sewing, diretor executivo do Deutsche Bank (DBKGn.DE) , ao jornal Bild em uma entrevista, referindo-se à ascensão dos extremos políticos.
“Não se pode esperar que um investidor estrangeiro faça imediatamente uma distinção entre um governo estadual e a Alemanha como um todo”, afirmou ele. “Isso é visto como a Alemanha como um todo e acho que, do ponto de vista do investidor, isso é compreensível.”
No Estado da Saxônia-Anhalt, a AfD — classificada pelos serviços de segurança como extremista em algumas regiões — ficou a um passo de obter a maioria absoluta no Parlamento estadual e, duas semanas depois, conquistou o primeiro lugar em Mecklemburgo-Pomerânia Ocidental.
A AfD tem sido acusada por economistas de promover um clima que afastará trabalhadores qualificados e investidores estrangeiros, muito necessários ao país.
O Esquerda, por sua vez, prometeu combater os custos crescentes da moradia em Berlim por meio da expropriação dos imóveis de empresas imobiliárias residenciais.
“E seja na Saxônia-Anhalt com a AfD ou o que está acontecendo aqui em Berlim, isso está longe de ser propício ao crescimento econômico. E está longe de ser favorável aos investimentos”, disse Sewing.
Ele instou o governo do chanceler Friedrich Merz a dar continuidade às reformas para reanimar a economia.
“Essa é a única resposta que temos aos extremistas de extrema-direita e de extrema-esquerda neste país”, declarou ele.
items.raw_description: O chefe do maior banco da Alemanha alertou que os investidores estrangeiros podem ser afastados após as vitórias obtidas nas eleições estaduais do mês passado por partidos de extremos políticos.

items.title: Iran says US response to its proposal to reopen Hormuz was 'insufficient'
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Washington needs to clarify the issues that remain unclear to Tehran, Iran's security chief said.
items.body:
The United States' response to Iran's seven conditions in a proposal to reopen the strategic Strait of Hormuz was "insufficient", Iran's security chief, Mohsen Rezaei, was quoted by state media on Sunday as saying.
Iran presented [USN:L1N45Q01J TEXT:"a proposal"] during the UN General Assembly under which the Strait of Hormuz waterway could be reopened and normal maritime passage restored within seven days if the conditions were met, to which the US later replied via Qatari intermediaries.
Washington needs to clarify the issues that remain unclear to Tehran, Rezaei, Secretary of the Supreme National Security Council, said, adding "we presented seven conditions to the Americans and clearly stated that the Strait of Hormuz would not be opened to them, and no negotiations would take place, until these conditions are met."
The White House did not immediately respond to a Reuters request for comment.
Rezaei said Iran is "no longer in the process of responding to the Americans".
"In their response, they have accepted some of our conditions, while others remain unclear," he added.
Tehran said late in September that it had [USN:L6N45M02H TEXT:"received a US response"] to its latest proposal to resurrect the collapsed ceasefire in the Gulf, days after US President Donald Trump said he had rejected it.
Qatar and other mediators have transmitted messages between Washington and Tehran in an effort to end the conflict and reopen the Strait of Hormuz, the conduit for a fifth of the world's oil and liquefied natural gas before the war that began at the end of February with US and Israeli attacks on Iran.

items.title: Arabia Saudita sufre otro ataque en su principal aeropuerto antes de dos grandes eventos internacionales
items.author: Sherif Tarek
items.summary: Un nuevo proyectil impactó una terminal del aeropuerto Rey Khalid un día después de un ataque que dejó 12 muertos y más de 300 heridos, mientras Riad se prepara para recibir a líderes del sector energ ...
items.body: Bloomberg — El principal aeropuerto de Arabia Saudita fue objeto de un nuevo ataque, un día después de que un ataque contra las instalaciones causara la muerte de 12 personas y aumentara la presión sobre la mayor economía de Medio Oriente, justo cuando se prepara para acoger importantes eventos destinados a impulsar la inversión extranjera. Un proyectil no identificado impactó el domingo en una terminal de pasajeros del Aeropuerto Internacional Rey Khalid de Riad, y las autoridades se enfrentaron a un incendio, según informó en un comunicado la coalición liderada por Arabia Saudita que lucha contra los rebeldes hutíes en Yemen. No se facilitaron detalles sobre la magnitud de los daños ni sobre el origen del ataque. La coalición también señaló que las defensas aéreas habían interceptado un misil cerca de la misma ubicación en la capital saudí. Ver más: Arabia Saudita cifra en 12 los muertos y 309 los heridos en un ataque al aeropuerto de Riad El incidente se produce tras un ataque contra el aeropuerto Rey Khalid el sábado, que también dejó más de 300 heridos y supuso el suceso más mortífero en Arabia Saudita desde que comenzó la guerra con Irán a finales de febrero. Ese ataque, del que la coalición culpó a los militantes hutíes de Yemen, respaldados por Irán, paralizó prácticamente el tráfico aéreo en el aeropuerto. Asimismo, obligó al centro financiero de Riad a pasar al teletrabajo hasta nuevo aviso y llevó a los directivos de BP Plc ( BP ) y Shell Plc ( SHEL ) a retirarse de un importante evento sobre energía que se celebraba en la ciudad esta semana. Las autoridades han indicado que el 25.º Congreso Mundial del Petróleo y los eventos asociados, que se celebrarán desde el domingo hasta el 15 de octubre, seguirán adelante. La ciudad también tiene previsto acoger la Future Investment Initiative, el encuentro de inversores más emblemático de Riad, a finales de este mes. Ver más: Arabia Saudita reanuda las exportaciones de petróleo por oleoducto clave tras ataques con drones Se prevé que ambos eventos atraigan a figuras destacadas del sector, entre ellas titanes de Wall Street como David Solomon, de Goldman Sachs ( GS ), y Larry Fink, de BlackRock ( BLK ). Los hutíes tomaron la capital yemení, Saná, en 2014 y llevan casi desde entonces luchando contra una coalición liderada por Arabia Saudita. El ataque del sábado se produjo menos de una semana después de que las fuerzas respaldadas por Arabia Saudita en Yemen lanzaran una campaña para recuperar las zonas controladas por los hutíes y “eliminar” al grupo. Los militantes, que con frecuencia reivindican ataques contra instalaciones petroleras saudíes, habían conquistado recientemente más territorio yemení y reforzado su control sobre Bab el-Mandeb, un punto estratégico para el transporte marítimo mundial. Ver más: Los hutíes se atribuyen un ataque a Arabia Saudita mientras EE. UU. pone fin a su serie de embestidas contra Irán La coalición liderada por Arabia Saudita calificó el “cobarde atentado terrorista” perpetrado el sábado contra el aeropuerto como “un auténtico crimen de guerra” cometido por los hutíes. Entre las víctimas se encontraban cuatro saudíes, un palestino, dos bangladesíes y una persona de cada uno de los siguientes países: Estados Unidos, Egipto, Jordania, Siria y Sudán, según las autoridades. Los hutíes no reivindicaron explícitamente el ataque del sábado, pero posteriormente advirtieron en un comunicado que los aeropuertos saudíes eran un objetivo y recomendaron al personal y a los viajeros que evitaran el espacio aéreo del país. items.title: Stellantis bets on small affordable EVs for European comeback
items.author: Giulio Piovaccari, Gilles Guillaume
items.creator: Giulio Piovaccari, Gilles Guillaume
items.summary: The presentations showcase the carmaker's bid to give brands more distinct identities as the industry's increasing reliance on shared platforms and technologies leads to broad design uniformity.
items.body:
Stellantis (STLAM.MI) heads into Paris Motor Show with a message it hopes customers, investors and dealers are ready to hear: after years of sliding market share and weak sales in Europe, the automaker is back in the fight.
At a Sunday gala event ahead of the show's opening, CEO Antonio Filosa unveiled six of the nine concept cars Stellantis is bringing to Paris alongside a range of production models, including affordable EVs set to compete with low-cost [USN:L1N45S104 TEXT:"Chinese rivals"].
The centrepiece is Citroen's revival of the iconic 2CV, a retro-styled concept previewing a European-made low-cost EV expected in 2028 and the first example of the group's plans for Europe's new "[USN:L8N41W0A6 TEXT:"e-car"]" category.
International premieres will include the DS7, Fiat Grizzly, Lancia Gamma, Opel Corsa GSE and the B03 and D19 models of Stellantis' Chinese partner Leapmotor (9863.HK) .
"This event brings our ... 2030 strategy to life," Filosa said. "It reflects the extraordinary effort of our teams and our commitment to shaping the future of mobility through iconic brands, compelling design and innovative technology."
The presentations showcase the carmaker's bid to give brands more distinct identities as the industry's increasing reliance on shared platforms and technologies leads to broad design uniformity.
"Each concept explores new ways to ... reinforce the unique identity of its brand," Stellantis design chief Gilles Vidal said.
The 2CV is probably Stellantis' "most interesting launch", said Pedro Pacheco, vice president of research at Gartner, offering an early test of whether European automakers can build affordable EVs without sacrificing quality, performance or safety.
"It will be the first example of what an e-car is going to be," Pacheco said.
With a price tag of around €15,000 ($16,800), [USN:S8N4150CD TEXT:"e-cars"] are a new category of low-cost EVs aimed at reviving Europe's shrinking entry-level car market.
The timing of Stellantis' strong return to a major European auto show after several years of maintaining a low profile is critical.
Investors want evidence that Filosa's turnaround plan is working after two years of declining market share and profitability in the group's two key regions, North America and Europe.
In a [USN:L8N41Y13N TEXT:"business plan"] through 2030 unveiled in May, Filosa promised dozens of new models, cost cuts and deeper cooperation with Chinese partners including [USN:L8N41L0GE TEXT:"Leapmotor"].
However, investors still need to be convinced that Stellantis is on the path to sustained recovery. Its shares fell to €3.81 this month, their lowest level since the group's formation in 2021.
Bernstein analysts, who cut the stock to "underperform" in August, said the world's fourth-largest automaker had yet to prove its turnaround was winning over buyers. They argued recent sales gains had been padded by higher deliveries to dealers to rebuild inventories rather than stronger consumer demand.
Felipe Munoz of Car Industry Analysis said Stellantis needed a more competitive lineup of electric models to counter the rapid expansion of Chinese automakers.
"They need to communicate they are still in the game," Munoz said. "Stellantis has been struggling ... but they are still relevant in Europe and they need to defend their position."
($1 = 0.8928 euros)

items.title: Antonelli dares to dream as historic F1 title zooms in to view
items.author: Tom Westbrook
items.creator: Tom Westbrook
items.summary: Mercedes' Kimi Antonelli said he is allowing himself to dream about a historic world title which is within reach at the next race in Austin, Texas, after the 20-year-old sealed his 14th podium finish of the season at Sunday's Singapore Grand Prix.
items.body:
Mercedes' Kimi Antonelli said he is allowing himself to dream about a historic world title which is within reach at the next race in Austin, Texas, after the 20-year-old sealed his 14th podium finish of the season at Sunday's Singapore Grand Prix.
The title would make Antonelli Formula One's youngest ever champion and Italy's first since 1953.
Antonelli's third place in a Singapore Grand Prix that was controlled from start to finish by Red Bull's Max Verstappen was scrappy, as he flirted with a penalty for testing the track's limits.
But it was enough to extend his lead over teammate George Russell to 102 points and when asked if he dared to dream of clinching the title in Austin later this month on the long journey home he said: "For sure.
"But at the same time, I know it's very close, I know it's there, but I just need to make sure that I keep doing the best I can. The mindset is always the same, to go out there and win.
"I think this weekend I haven't particularly driven that well... but I feel confident that, (with) a week to reset and I'm really looking forward to being back in Austin.
"If I don't do my job well, then the result won't come. So in order to achieve what I want, I need to perform at 100%."
SOONER OR LATER Antonelli can mathematically win the championship in Austin on the assumption there are still five races to come after, with the fate of the Grands Prix in Qatar and Abu Dhabi up in the air due to the conflict in the Middle East.
However, Mercedes boss Toto Wolff is refusing to tempt fate.
"I remind myself that this is motor racing and crazy things have happened," Wolff said.
"It probably needs the other two (contenders), George and Lewis (Hamilton), to retire and him winning. So this is not a likely scenario," he added, while recognising that the title was within reach and maybe inevitable.
"It's going to come towards him, whether that's in Mexico or Brazil, or far down the line."
MERCEDES UPGRADES Russell, who worked his way up from the back of the starting grid due to engine penalties, finished a respectable ninth at the Marina Bay Street Circuit, where overtaking is notoriously tricky.
Wolff said both drivers would probably be running in Austin on an upgraded car as some, but not all, of its teething problems had been ironed out in Singapore.
"I think that this new car needs a very different setup philosophy than the previous car," he said.
"Does it have the performance that we were hoping the upgrade would bring? I don't think so yet, but it was a step in the right direction."
Antonelli narrowly avoided a five-second penalty, hitting the maximum limit of breaches of the track boundaries.
However, Wolff praised his driving and joked about how he could boost the diminutive driver higher for a better view of the track edges.
"I have a good strategy. I'm going to put a pillow from the hotel under his arse, so he can actually see the road."

items.title: Saudi-led coalition says new attack at Riyadh airport day after strike killed 12, including one Indian: Details here
items.author: Trisha Bhattacharya
items.summary: A fresh attack on Riyadh airport sparked a fire at Terminal 4 on Sunday, a day after a strike killed 12 people and injured more than 300. One Indian national has since died, while 10 others remain injured, the Indian Embassy said.
items.body: A fresh attack on Riyadh’s King Khalid International Airport sparked a fire at Terminal 4 on Sunday, a day after a deadly strike killed 12 people and injured more than 300. One Indian national who was injured in Saturday’s attack has since died, External Affairs Minister S Jaishankar said, while 10 other Indians remain injured.Riyadh airport attacked one day after deadly strikeOne Indian national has died and 10 others remain injured following the deadly attack on Riyadh’s King Khalid International Airport, External Affairs Minister S Jaishankar said in a post on X on Sunday, as Saudi Arabia reported a fresh attack that caused a fire at the airport a day after a strike killed 12 people.“Deeply grieved at the loss of life of an Indian national in the Riyadh attack. My heartfelt condolences to the bereaved family. The Embassy will extend all possible assistance (sic),” Jaishankar wrote.The Indian Embassy in Riyadh also confirmed the death, saying the Indian national had succumbed to injuries sustained in the 10 October attack. It said it was in contact with the family and would provide assistance with the repatriation of the deceased’s mortal remains.They wrote, “Update regarding Riyadh Airport attack on October 10. It is learnt that one Indian national injured in the Riyadh attack has unfortunately lost his life today. We convey our heartfelt condolences to the family of the deceased. We are in touch with the family and will provide all support for ensuring the early repatriation of mortal remains (sic).”Fresh attack sparks fire at Terminal 4The Saudi-led coalition in Yemen reported a new incident at Riyadh airport on Sunday, saying an unidentified projectile struck Terminal 4 and caused a fire. The report came a day after the deadly attack on the airport, which forced authorities to suspend operations while damage and safety assessments were carried out.The latest incident has added to concerns over the security of Saudi Arabia’s aviation infrastructure, with the airport having faced multiple attacks in the space of a week. Reuters reported that Saturday’s assault was the deadliest attack of its kind in the kingdom in more than a decade.Houthis renew warning to airlines and travelersYemen’s Iran-backed Houthi movement renewed its warning on Sunday to airlines, airport employees and travellers, urging them to stay away from Saudi airports and airspace. The group said the warning did not apply to airports in the holy cities of Mecca and Medina.The warning comes amid escalating fighting between the Houthis and Saudi-backed Yemeni government forces. Saudi Arabia has supported a military campaign against the group, deepening tensions across the region.The attacks have also prompted international concern over the targeting of civilian infrastructure. India strongly condemned the repeated strikes on Riyadh’s airport, describing attacks that cause civilian casualties and damage as unacceptable and calling for them to stop immediately. New Delhi also expressed solidarity with Saudi Arabia and offered condolences to the families of those killed.As the situation develops, the Indian Embassy has said it remains in contact with local authorities and hospitals to monitor the condition of the injured nationals and assist those affected by the attack.

items.title: UK PM Burnham says Russia interfered in 2016 Brexit vote
items.author: Andrew Macaskill
items.creator: Andrew Macaskill
items.summary: British Prime Minister Andy Burnham said Russia interfered in the 2016 Brexit vote, as he warned voters in France and Germany about Moscow-backed efforts to influence their politics.
items.body:
British Prime Minister Andy Burnham said Russia interfered in the 2016 Brexit vote, as he warned voters in France and Germany about Moscow-backed efforts to influence their politics.
Burnham, who took over as Britain's leader in July and said last month that Britain could consider [USN:L1N45M0A5 TEXT:"rejoining the European Union"] in the future, is the first British prime minister to say openly there was evidence of Russian interference in the referendum a decade ago.
"I asked the question coming to Downing Street, was there interference in the 2016 referendum from Russia? And I've had the clear answer that yes, there was," Burnham said in an interview with The Rest Is Politics podcast released on Sunday.
Burnham did not spell out how he believed that Russia interfered in the referendum and gave no details on what evidence this statement was based.
The Russian embassy in London did not immediately respond to a request for comment.
Russia has previously denied meddling in the Brexit vote, casting Britain as gripped by anti-Russian hysteria.
Burnham's comments mark a departure from those of former Prime Minister Boris Johnson, who campaigned to leave the EU, and said in 2020 there was no evidence of Russian interference in the referendum.
[USN:L8N42P12C TEXT:"Britons voted 52%-48%"] to leave the EU in 2016, plunging the country into its biggest political crisis since World War Two.
Burnham said voters in European democracies needed to be better informed about efforts to disrupt their politics.
"I mean, these things are important now to put clearly on the record, and I believe, help voters in Germany and France understand that some of this politics is instigated via our enemies, namely Russia," he said.
Britain's government failed to establish whether Russia meddled in the 2016 referendum on membership of the EU, according to a report by parliament's Intelligence and Security Committee in 2020.
The report also found that Russia had sought to influence Scotland's 2014 independence referendum, in which voters rejected independence.
Burnham last month said he could campaign to take Britain back into the EU at the next general election, reopening the country’s divisive debate on its relationship with the continent.

items.title: France Raphaël Glucksmann remporte la primaire sociale-démocrate dès le premier tour
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Le candidat Place Publique à l'élection présidentielle, Raphaël Glucksmann, a remporté dès le premier tour la primaire sociale-démocrate, a annoncé dimanche le Parti socialiste.
items.body:
Le candidat Place Publique à l'élection présidentielle, Raphaël Glucksmann, a remporté dès le premier tour la primaire sociale-démocrate, a annoncé dimanche le Parti socialiste.
L'eurodéputé de 46 ans a recueilli 66,13% des suffrages, devant le premier secrétaire du Parti socialiste Olivier Faure, à 14,48%, au terme d'une campagne qui a vu les cinq candidats s'affronter lors de trois débats télévisés.
L'ancienne ministre Ségolène Royal et les députés socialistes Emmanuel Maurel et Jérôme Guedj ont recueilli respectivement 7,62%, 5,92% et 5,83% des voix.
Près de 135.000 personnes s'étaient inscrites pour participer à cette primaire, un chiffre bien inférieur aux précédents scrutins internes - 2,8 millions de participants, par exemple, à la primaire de 2011 remportée par le futur président François Hollande.
Entre autres divergences avec Olivier Faure, Raphaël Glucksmann est hostile à toute alliance avec La France insoumise de Jean-Luc Mélenchon, lui aussi candidat à l'Elysée.

items.title: Vinícius Jr pede desculpas após receber cartão vermelho por puxar cabelo de jogador do Villarreal
items.author: Ruairidh Barlow
items.creator: Ruairidh Barlow
items.summary: Vinícius Jr, do Real Madrid, pediu desculpas aos companheiros de equipe e aos torcedores do clube após ter sido expulso na vitória por 1 x 0 sobre o Villarreal pela LaLiga, no Santiago Bernabéu, no sábado.
items.body:
Vinícius Jr, do Real Madrid, pediu desculpas aos companheiros de equipe e aos torcedores do clube após ter sido expulso na vitória por 1 x 0 sobre o Villarreal pela LaLiga, no Santiago Bernabéu, no sábado.
Vinícius agora enfrenta uma espera tensa pela decisão da comissão disciplinar, que pode fazê-lo perder o confronto do Real contra o rival Barcelona, no dia 25 de outubro, no Camp Nou.
O brasileiro pensou ter marcado o segundo gol do Real, mas o gol foi anulado depois que uma revisão do VAR constatou que ele deveria ser expulso por ter puxado o cabelo de Nathan Saliba na jogada que antecedeu o lance.
Após a partida, Vinícius, que entrou em campo aos 7 minutos do segundo tempo e recebeu o cartão vermelho 20 minutos depois, postou nas redes sociais: “Perdão à minha equipe e à torcida”.
Os regulamentos da Federação Espanhola de Futebol estabelecem que puxar o cabelo de um adversário é considerado conduta violenta.
A punição por conduta violenta sem causar lesão a um adversário (Artigo 130) é a suspensão de um a três jogos.
Os próximos três jogos do Real na LaLiga serão contra o Sevilla, o Barça e o Racing Santander, mas perder o El Clásico seria um duro golpe para o jogador da seleção brasileira de 26 anos.

items.body:
Pelo menos 139 imigrantes, incluindo pelo menos 15 crianças, morreram e cerca de 84 estavam desaparecidos depois que um barco que transportava mais de 300 pessoas virou enquanto navegava de Djibuti para o Iêmen, informou no domingo a Organização Internacional para as Migrações (OIM), das Nações Unidas.
O barco, que transportava 305 pessoas, virou perto de Guhere, ao norte de Obock — uma cidade portuária em Djibuti — durante a noite de 8 para 9 de outubro, informou a OIM, citando relatos de sobreviventes.
Cerca de 82 pessoas sobreviveram ao naufrágio, segundo o comunicado. Um porta-voz do governo etíope não respondeu imediatamente aos pedidos de comentário.
Fotografias compartilhadas pela agência da ONU mostraram sandálias e tênis gastos levados pela maré até a praia.
“Nossas equipes estão no local, em conjunto com as autoridades locais, para prestar assistência de emergência”, disse Alexandre Coissac, chefe da missão da OIM em Djibuti.
“Essa tragédia é um forte lembrete dos perigos enfrentados pelos imigrantes ao longo desse corredor imigratório enquanto buscam oportunidades econômicas”, declarou Coissac.
As autoridades de Djibuti continuam as operações de busca e resgate, informou o comunicado da OIM, acrescentando que as autoridades locais também estão prestando atendimento médico aos sobreviventes e providenciando o enterro dos falecidos.
O governo de Djibuti não pôde ser contatado imediatamente para comentar o caso.
Os imigrantes seguiam para o Iêmen, com a esperança de, eventualmente, chegar aos países mais ricos do Golfo, mesmo enquanto os próprios cidadãos iemenitas fogem de seu país, que está passando pela mais grave escalada nos combates entre as forças governamentais apoiadas pela Arábia Saudita e os houthis apoiados pelo Irã desde a trégua mediada pela ONU em 2022.
“Apesar da violência no Iêmen, os imigrantes continuam a empreender essas viagens perigosas na esperança de chegar aos países do Golfo”, afirmou o comunicado da OIM.

items.title: ウクライナとロシアがエネ施設攻撃停止で合意、トランプ氏投稿　「詳細待つ」とゼレンスキー氏
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Daniel Flynn　Steve Holland

［キエフ／ワシントン　１１日　ロイター］ -
items.body:
Daniel Flynn　Steve Holland

［キエフ／ワシントン　１１日　ロイター］ - トランプ米大統領は１１日、ロシアとウクライナが双方のエネルギー関連施設への攻撃停止で「合意した」と自身の交流サイト（ＳＮＳ）に投稿した。即時発効するとしたが、詳細は明らかにしていない。ウクライナのゼレンスキー大統領は、合意は初耳とし、詳細を待っていると述べた。

ゼレンスキー氏は、米ニュースサイトのアクシオスとのインタビューで、トランプ氏の投稿で合意を初めて知ったと述べた。その後、通信アプリ「テレグラム」に「ウクライナは停戦を支持する。ロシアも支持することが重要だ。米国側からの詳細を待っている」と投稿した。トランプ氏の発表について、北大西洋条約機構（ＮＡＴＯ）のルッテ事務総長、カナダのカーニー首相、フィンランドのストゥブ大統領と協議したと明らかにした。「ウクライナとしては、緊張緩和に向けた措置、人命の保護、そして戦争を終結させて永続的な平和を保証するために必要な決定を、常に全面的に支持する」と述べた。

ゼレンスキー氏は１１日これより先、ロシアがウクライナの電力インフラへの攻撃を停止する場合に限り、ロシアの製油所への攻撃を停止する用意があるという従来の方針を改めて示した。いかなる合意にも「真の保証」が必要だと指摘し、「エネルギーインフラへの攻撃は早ければ今日にも停止できるが、プーチン（ロシア大統領）がそれを望んでいない」と述べていた。

＜停戦なら選挙実施とゼレンスキー氏＞

トランプ氏は１０日、ウクライナによるロシアの製油所への攻撃が世界の軽油供給に打撃を与えていると批判し、「ウクライナは新しい大統領を選ぶときだと思う」と述べた。

ゼレンスキー氏は１１日、米ＡＢＣテレビの番組で、プーチン氏が６０日間の停戦に合意すればウクライナで選挙を実施すると語った。ウクライナの法律は治安上の理由から戒厳令下の選挙を禁止している。

同氏は、まずは戦闘停止が不可欠だと指摘。「プーチン氏に伝えてほしい。２カ月、６０日間の全面停戦を与えてくれれば、われわれは選挙を実施する」と述べた。

また、エネルギー価格上昇の責任を負わされることを拒否し、中東での戦争の方が大きな要因であることは「世界中の誰もが」知っていると指摘した。

＜防空能力強化で欧州と協議＞

ゼレンスキー氏は、１１日も欧州首脳との協議を継続すると述べ、ロシアのジェット推進型無人機の撃墜に用いられる戦闘機用弾薬を含む追加の防空支援策を巡り連日対話が行われているとした。

ウクライナのシビハ外相は１２日、欧州連合（ＥＵ）外相理事会に出席する予定で、ロシアへの制裁圧力強化やウクライナのＥＵ加盟交渉の前進について協議する見通しだ。

items.title: Prominent Republican senator says Trump's Russian diesel deal may be illegal
items.author: Jan Wolfe
items.creator: Jan Wolfe
items.summary: Republican US Senator Thom Tillis on Sunday said President Donald Trump's diesel supply deal with Russia may be illegal and will put American lives at risk, adding to bipartisan criticism of the arrangement announced by the president on Friday.
items.body:
Republican US Senator Thom Tillis on Sunday said President Donald Trump 's [USN:S0N43U024 TEXT:"diesel supply deal"] with Russia may be illegal and will put American lives at risk, adding to bipartisan criticism of the arrangement announced by the president on Friday.
Trump said that Russia had agreed to supply diesel to global markets, and his administration temporarily lifted US sanctions on Russian fuel that were designed to deprive Moscow of revenue for its war on Ukraine .
“I do believe there’s a legitimate case for saying the president’s not following the law,” said Tillis, an influential Republican from North Carolina who is retiring from the Senate at the end of his term in January.
Prices for diesel — used for agriculture, heating homes and trucking — are near record highs and could hurt Trump's fellow Republicans in next month's congressional elections that will determine whether they maintain their thin majorities in Congress.
Analysts have said Trump's agreement with Moscow was unlikely to lead to sustained lower fuel prices.
US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent told Fox News on Sunday that the Trump administration will follow through with the deal using existing legal authority, adding that the agreement was good for the American people and would bring prices down.
"We're going to do it with all the legal authorities we have. So, you know, anyone in Congress who says whether it's an old bill or the current Lindsey Graham bill (that) prohibits us from doing it is wrong," Bessent told the "Fox & Friends" program.
Trump last month signed a sweeping Russia sanctions bill into law, called the "Lindsey O. Graham Sanctioning Russia and Iran Act of 2026," to honor the South Carolina Republican who died in July. Graham, a longtime Russia hawk, was a staunch backer of the legislation.
Tillis is not the first Republican to criticize the deal. Retiring Representative Don Bacon of Nebraska said on X on Friday that "propping up Putin’s war economy is morally wrong as he uses that money to bomb cities."
Mike Pence, Trump's former vice president, called his decision to lift sanctions on Russian oil a "betrayal" of Graham’s legacy and urged the president to "rescind" it.
"The president's actions and his comments over the last 24 hours are the exact opposite of the intent of that bill," Tillis said, adding, "I will guarantee you at the first opportunity ( Russian President Vladimir) Putin has to embarrass or undermine President Trump, he will."
As Trump's poll numbers have [USN:L6N45D0NV TEXT:"cratered"], congressional Republicans have increasingly [USN:L4N45N1R0 TEXT:"distanced themselves"] from the president, on matters ranging from the conflict in Iran to the trade war with Canada.
The Senate's No. 2 Republican, John Barrasso of Wyoming, defended the diesel deal on Sunday, telling CBS' "Face the Nation" that Trump is focused on bringing costs down for consumers, ranchers, farmers and truckers.
"The president is balancing and has to make tough decisions," Barrasso said.

items.title: Manchester City met at Anfield with boos and 'cheat' taunts
items.author: Lori Ewing
items.creator: Lori Ewing
items.summary: Fans drowned out the announcement of City's team with earsplitting boos and chants of "Going down, going down, going down!" in reference to a possible relegation sanction.
items.body:
Premier League leaders Manchester City came to Liverpool's Anfield stadium on Sunday to find the fallout from their financial rules verdict waiting at the gates.
It was their first game since being found guilty of [USN:L8N3Q11LI TEXT:"114 breaches"] of the league's financial rules, and Liverpool supporters had prepared a blunt welcome.
Fans drowned out the announcement of City's team with earsplitting boos and chants of "Going down, going down!" in reference to a possible relegation sanction.
City deny the charges and are appealing.
In a raucous atmosphere among some 60,000 supporters at Anfield, one banner read: "A Generation Of Supporters Cheated" while some fans held three balloons making the number 114.
Another two banners referenced Oasis songs, since the band's Liam and Noel Gallagher are devoted City fans.
"All of your stars are fading away," read one, changing a line from the song "Stop Crying Your Heart Out," while another said "& after all, you really robbed us all," a parody of the song "Wonderwall."
Liverpool fans are particularly angry as they were narrowly pipped to the Premier League title three times by Manchester City during the period in which they were deemed to have broken financial rules.
"If they only get, say, a demotion to the Championship, and they can come back in one season, that's not enough. It should be more," said lifelong Liverpool fan David Matthias.
"And as far as the titles they've won, I'd be quite happy to see them stripped of everything."
BANANAS BACK Travelling City fans, meanwhile, held aloft inflatable bananas, a humorous tradition dating from their time out of the top flight in the 1980s.
And they had the last laugh on the day, celebrating wildly after their team [USN:L1N45X053 TEXT:"won 3-0"] to subdue the Anfield faithful.
"For every single fan, this is a lovely moment, which will stay with us for a long time," said goalscorer Erling Haaland.
"It was tough and it was hard, but again we showed amazing character ... It's about these times to stay strong mentally, stick together, and do what you can do something about, and what we can do is to play good football and to fight together, because at the end, that's the only thing we can do."
Outside Liverpool's ground, souvenir stalls did brisk business in flags and T-shirts bearing the word: "CHEATS."
One flag depicted former City manager Pep Guardiola alongside players including Haaland dressed in black-and-red prison stripes, with "CHEATS" splashed across their backs and prisoner number 114.
It was gallows humour with a football twist, and a sign that the repercussions of the ruling had quickly spilled from hearing rooms into the tribal theatre of the Premier League.
Merseyside police had been on high alert amid concerns [USN:L8N45V0N7 TEXT:"City's team bus"] could be targeted after a social media post promoted a "Bus greeting."
But while Liverpool supporters lining Anfield Road held aloft flares and sang anti-City songs, the team took an alternate quieter route to the stadium.
In 2018, City's team bus was struck by bottles, cans and flares before a Champions League match at Anfield and was damaged badly enough that a replacement was required for the journey back to Manchester.

items.title: 'Not a good weekend for me': Norris rues poor decision-making in Singapore
items.author: Rohith Nair, Tom Westbrook
items.creator: Rohith Nair, Tom Westbrook
items.summary: McLaren's Lando Norris delivered a harsh self-assessment after a weekend of costly mistakes at the Singapore Grand Prix, conceding on Sunday his decision-making let him down once again as a potential podium position slipped through his fingers.
items.body:
McLaren's Lando Norris delivered a harsh self-assessment after a weekend of costly mistakes at the Singapore Grand Prix, conceding on Sunday his decision-making let him down once again as a potential podium position slipped through his fingers.
After apologising for [USN:L4N45W018 TEXT:"colliding with teammate Oscar Piastri"] on the final lap in Saturday's sprint that cost the McLarens fourth and fifth, Norris had the opportunity to take third place from Ferrari's Lewis Hamilton in [USN:L1N45X03I TEXT:"Sunday's race"].
As Hamilton's pace collapsed in the final stages, Norris attempted to pass his compatriot but the Ferrari driver went wide while he went on the dirty part of the track, allowing Mercedes' Kimi Antonelli to pounce and move up.
"I should have done a better job battling Lewis. It was inevitable that I was going to pass him at some point, I just shouldn't have tried to overtake him when I did," Norris said after finishing fourth.
"I braked a bit late and could have still put a good move in and he would have had to let me pass because he braked way too late. A bit unnecessary from me.
"Not a good weekend for me in terms of making decisions like that."
McLaren face mounting pressure in the constructors' championship after Red Bull's Max Verstappen won the last two races in Sepang and Singapore.
Red Bull, fourth in the constructors' standings, are now within seven points of third-placed McLaren and Norris was pessimistic about his team's chances of holding off their rivals.
'WORST OF THE TOP FOUR' "We can't (catch up) unless we bring upgrades and we don't have anything for a little bit," said Norris, the reigning champion who is sixth in the standings this year.
"At the minute we're fourth-fastest back to the top group, which is closer than we were at the beginning of the year and we can still fight pretty well.
"We're still fighting for top four and almost for podiums but we're still too far off and we're the worst of the top four teams. We just have to keep upgrading the car."
However, McLaren team principal Andrea Stella said they had learned more about their cars after races in Sepang and Singapore.
"I think there's no big surprises. It was good to see that here in Singapore, we are where we expected to be," he said.
"Verstappen and Red Bull are just taking advantage of the upgrades that they have delivered and it's what we call, this season, the ping pong.
"Basically, people come with upgrades, even if like in the case of Mercedes, I understand that they have some issues themselves. But people coming with upgrades, they can take a little step forward."
items.raw_description: McLaren's Lando Norris delivered a harsh self-assessment after a weekend of costly mistakes at the Singapore Grand Prix, conceding on Sunday his decision-making let him down once again as a potential podium position slipped through his fingers.

items.title: El papa León XIV será operado para extirparle un nódulo en el pulmón
items.author: Vernon Silver
items.summary: Los médicos detectaron el nódulo pulmonar en una fase localizada y muy inicial. La operación está prevista para principios de esta semana, antes de su viaje a Uruguay, Argentina y Perú en noviembre.
items.body: Bloomberg — El papa León XIV anunció que se someterá a una operación en los próximos días para extirparle un nódulo en el pulmón. Durante su bendición dominical habitual, el papa, nacido en Estados Unidos, dijo que los médicos descubrieron el nódulo en una fase localizada y muy inicial. Ver más: Papa León dice que la tecnología debe ayudar a las personas y advierte sobre la “deshumanización” “Siguiendo su consejo, decidí operarme para extirparlo”, dijo desde la ventana de su apartamento con vistas a la Plaza de San Pedro, hablando en italiano. “La operación ya está programada para los próximos días”. Posteriormente, el Vaticano anunció que la operación tendrá lugar a principios de esta semana, con un tiempo estimado de recuperación de una semana. Ver más: Esta será la agenda completa del papa León XIV en Uruguay, Argentina y Perú en noviembre Leo, de 71 años, fue elegido líder de los 1.400 millones de católicos del mundo el año pasado. La cirugía está programada para pocas semanas antes de su viaje a Sudamérica. Dicho viaje, del 6 al 17 de noviembre, lo llevará a 10 ciudades de Uruguay, Argentina y Perú, países donde desarrolló gran parte de su carrera y donde posee una segunda nacionalidad. Lea más en Bloomberg.com

items.title: Au moins 139 migrants périssent dans un naufrage au large de Djibouti
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Au moins 139 migrants, dont 15 enfants, ont péri et environ 84 autres sont portés disparus après le naufrage d'une embarcation transportant 305 personnes entre Djibouti et le Yémen, a annoncé dimanche l'Organisation internationale pour les migrations (OIM), une agence des Nations unies.
items.body:
Au moins 139 migrants, dont 15 enfants, ont péri et environ 84 autres sont portés disparus après le naufrage d'une embarcation transportant 305 personnes entre Djibouti et le Yémen, a annoncé dimanche l'Organisation internationale pour les migrations (OIM), une agence des Nations unies.
L'embarcation a chaviré près de Guhere, au nord d'Obock, ville portuaire de Djibouti, dans la nuit du 8 au 9 octobre, a précisé l'OIM, citant les témoignages de survivants.
Environ 82 personnes ont survécu au naufrage, selon le communiqué. Un porte-parole du gouvernement éthiopien n'a pas répondu dans l'immédiat aux demandes de commentaires.
Des photographies diffusées par l'agence de l'Onu montrent des sandales et des baskets usées rejetées sur le rivage.
"Nos équipes sont sur le terrain aux côtés des autorités locales pour fournir une aide d'urgence", a déclaré Alexandre Coissac, chef de mission de l'OIM à Djibouti.
"Cette tragédie rappelle brutalement les dangers auxquels sont confrontés les migrants sur cette route migratoire lorsqu'ils cherchent des opportunités économiques", a-t-il ajouté.
Les autorités djiboutiennes poursuivent les opérations de recherche et de sauvetage, a indiqué l'OIM, précisant qu'elles fournissent également des soins médicaux aux survivants et organisent l'inhumation des victimes.
Le gouvernement de Djibouti n'a pas pu être joint dans l'immédiat pour un commentaire.
Les migrants se dirigeaient vers le Yémen dans l'espoir de rejoindre ensuite les Etats plus riches du Golfe, alors même que des Yéménites fuient leur propre pays, confronté à la plus grave recrudescence des affrontements entre les forces gouvernementales soutenues par l'Arabie saoudite et les Houthis soutenus par l'Iran depuis la trêve négociée par l'Onu en 2022.
"Malgré les violences au Yémen, les migrants continuent d'emprunter cette route périlleuse dans l'espoir d'atteindre les pays du Golfe", souligne le communiqué de l'OIM.
DES MIGRANTS FUIENT LES AFFRONTEMENTS EN ÉTHIOPIE Des affrontements ont également éclaté en Éthiopie depuis le mois de septembre, marquant la plus importante escalade de violence dans le pays depuis la guerre du Tigré de 2020-2022.
Un responsable de l'OIM a indiqué à Reuters que l'agence onusienne observait depuis plusieurs années un important flux migratoire sur la "route orientale" passant par Djibouti.
"Les gens continuent d'utiliser cette route dans un contexte d'évolution de la situation en Éthiopie et au Yémen, même si le volume et la direction des mouvements peuvent varier au fil du temps", a-t-il déclaré.
Des migrants éthiopiens interrogés dans le cadre du dernier rapport de situation de l'agence sur Djibouti, couvrant la période du 20 au 30 septembre, ont indiqué avoir quitté leur pays en raison de conditions de vie difficiles, liées notamment à la sécheresse.
"Certains migrants ont également indiqué qu'ils fuyaient les conflits et les recrutements forcés par des forces armées", précise le rapport.
Plusieurs habitants du Tigré, où les combats ont éclaté le 23 septembre, ont indiqué à Reuters avoir vu des rebelles tigréens enrôler de force de jeunes hommes, ce que les rebelles ont nié.
Le conflit fait craindre un retour à une guerre ouverte, l'Éthiopie et l'Érythrée ayant rompu leurs relations sur fond d'accusations selon lesquelles l'Érythrée soutiendrait une alliance rebelle cherchant à renverser le gouvernement d'Addis-Abeba. L'Érythrée dément tout soutien à cette alliance.
La "route orientale" comporte de nombreux dangers, notamment des accidents en mer, la traite d'êtres humains et des arrestations arbitraires une fois à terre. En 2025, plus de 900 migrants sont morts ou ont disparu sur cet itinéraire, selon le projet "Missing Migrants" de l'OIM, alors que le nombre de personnes empruntant cette route a augmenté de 18%.
L'OIM a qualifié d'alarmante la crise provoquée par les combats au Yémen. Le nombre de déplacés est passé à 200.000, contre 76.000 à la mi-septembre, selon des données publiées par l'agence la semaine dernière.
Plus de 3.700 personnes ont fui le Yémen par voie maritime vers Djibouti jusqu'à la semaine dernière, a-t-elle ajouté.
