items.title: Arábia Saudita relata feridos em novo ataque a aeroporto de Riad um dia após 13 mortes
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Os houthis do Iêmen, alinhados ao Irã, reivindicaram a autoria do ataque de sábado ao aeroporto internacional de Riad — que deixou 13 mortos e mais de 300 feridos — enquanto autoridades sauditas relataram feridos em um novo ataque ao aeroporto neste domingo.
items.body:
Os houthis do Iêmen, alinhados ao Irã, reivindicaram a autoria do ataque de sábado ao aeroporto internacional de Riad — que deixou 13 mortos e mais de 300 feridos — enquanto autoridades sauditas relataram feridos em um novo ataque ao aeroporto neste domingo.
A coalizão liderada pela Arábia Saudita no Iêmen informou que um “projétil não identificado” atingiu o aeroporto internacional de Riad no domingo, causando um incêndio. Um número não especificado de pessoas ficou ferido, informou a autoridade de aviação civil da Arábia Saudita, acrescentando que ainda estava avaliando os danos.
A coalizão informou ainda que as defesas aéreas sauditas interceptaram um míssil de cruzeiro nas proximidades do Aeroporto Internacional Rei Khalid.
Os ataques expuseram vulnerabilidades nas capacidades de defesa da Arábia Saudita, enquanto o reino conduz uma campanha aérea contra os houthis para apoiar a guerra terrestre travada no Iêmen pelo governo iemenita contra o grupo alinhado ao Irã.
O aeroporto permanece fechado desde o ataque de sábado. No entanto, uma conferência internacional de energia, planejada há muito tempo, foi realizada em Riad no domingo, conforme o previsto.
HOUTHIS ASSUMEM AUTORIA DE OUTROS ATAQUES Em um discurso televisionado no domingo, o porta-voz militar dos houthis, Yahya Saree, assumiu a responsabilidade pelo ataque de sábado e afirmou também que o grupo havia atacado o aeroporto de Dammam, na Província Oriental da Arábia Saudita, e duas instalações da gigante petrolífera saudita Saudi Aramco.
Não houve confirmação imediata por parte da Arábia Saudita. A Reuters entrou em contato com o escritório de imprensa saudita e com a Aramco para obter comentários.
Anteriormente, os houthis haviam dito em um comunicado no X: “Reiteramos nosso alerta a todas as companhias aéreas, especialistas, funcionários, trabalhadores e viajantes contra o uso de aeroportos e do espaço aéreo sauditas, pois eles estão vulneráveis a ataques e se tornaram um teatro de operações para nossas forças, com exceção dos aeroportos em (cidades sagradas de) Meca e Medina.”
“Exortamos todos a levarem nossos alertas a sério, e a Arábia Saudita é responsável por quaisquer interceptações malsucedidas.”
A Arábia Saudita intensificou seu envolvimento militar no Iêmen nas últimas semanas, lançando ataques contra os houthis e apoiando uma contraofensiva do governo iemenita depois que o grupo tomou território estratégico ao longo da costa do Mar Vermelho no mês passado.
O Ministério das Relações Exteriores do Iêmen, administrado pelos houthis, afirmou no domingo, mais tarde, que novas ações militares sauditas no Iêmen provocariam uma resposta mais forte, acrescentando que suas ações seriam orientadas pelo princípio da reciprocidade.
“A menos que o inimigo saudita pare com sua agressão e interferência no Iêmen, o pior ainda está por vir, se Deus quiser”, afirmou o ministério em declarações veiculadas pela emissora de TV Al Masirah, controlada pelos houthis.
O presidente Donald Trump disse no sábado que os Estados Unidos estavam considerando se juntar aos ataques sauditas contra os houthis no conflito, uma ramificação da guerra mais ampla contra o Irã que EUA e Israel lançaram em fevereiro.

items.title: Starlink services in India need to be affordable: SpaceX CEO Elon Musk
items.author: Gulveen Aulakh
items.summary: Starlink’s services in India have to be affordable for more people, and competition would benefit the customer even though it would mean Reliance Jio would make less money “but won’t go out of ...
items.body: Starlink’s services in India have to be affordable for more people, and competition would benefit the customer even though it would mean Reliance Jio would make less money “but won’t go out of business”, according to SpaceX founder Elon Musk. Days ahead of Jio’s expected initial public offering (IPO), likely to be India’s largest, potentially valuing Jio at over $100 billion, Musk took yet another shot at the Reliance group as he called it a “de facto monopoly in India”.   “The ridiculous arguments by Ambani’s army of Internet shills make no sense. On the one hand, they say Starlink couldn’t possibly compete with the amazing low prices offered by Ambani’s de facto monopoly in India and then, in the same breath, they essentially claim that Starlink would be too strong of a competitor! This is absurd hypocrisy and hyperbole,” he said in a post in early hours of Sunday (India time) on social media platform X, which he owns, in response to several posts from users who, he alleged, were supporters of Reliance Industries Ltd (RIL). RIL did not respond to Musk’s comments till Sunday evening. “The reality is that competition would greatly benefit the average citizen in India by giving them more choices, as it always does. Ambani’s profits will be lower, but he is not going out of business. And, obviously, if Starlink is too expensive in India, no one will buy it, so SpaceX will need to make pricing affordable,” he added.   His comments follow a series of posts questioning the delays in approval to Starlink’s services in India while also alleging that certain business conglomerates, subsequently naming the Reliance group, were blocking Starlink’s India entry. On Saturday, Musk had posted, “Dear Prime Minister Ambani, please accept my humble apologies for not realizing that you are the real boss of India. Naturally, you would prefer to maintain your monopolistic exploitation of the great people of India, but would you nonetheless consider allowing Starlink to compete?” He said Starlink could benefit users, including small businesses and children’s education, in areas of India that did not have internet access, while also being useful in saving lives during natural disasters when other communication systems went down. Musk’s allegations drew sharp criticism.   Nishikant Dubey, chairman of the Parliamentary Committee on Communications and Information Technology, said in response to Musk's post that the government was aware of the challenges (through Starlink) facing the country’s security agencies since 2013-14, and the Ministry of Defence, the Ministry of Home Affairs, and investigation agencies were being affected by the dangerous games of these threats. “First, provide connections to the poor in your own country, America, at affordable rates, and then level accusations—India is a healthy democratic, sovereign nation; it does not change its security policy under pressure or social media,” he said. Former NITI Aayog vice-chairman Rajiv Kumar said that India could and should challenge Musk’s monopoly in space-based communications, using the $145 billion in the USO (Universal Service Obligation) fund. “This should now be utilised to help Indian telecom network providers like @airtelindia and @reliancejio to urgently put up their satellite networks to compete with @elonmusk Starlink. This will be far better use than wait indefinitely for BSNL to develop the required capacity for achieving universal coverage. India can and should challenge Musk’s monopoly in space based communications,” he said in a post on X, on Sunday.   Bharti group-backed Eutelsat OneWeb (now Eutelsat Group) and Jio Satellite Communications, a subsidiary of Reliance Jio, have been awarded the licence but those await security clearances. Starlink received its last approval in 2025, while Eutelsat and Jio received theirs earlier. Jio is separately building its low-earth orbit (LEO) satellite constellation, which will rival that of global players like Starlink and Amazon Leo.  The government has refuted Musk’s claims, stating last week that all satellite broadband providers had to comply with security norms to operate in India. The communications ministry said that the country’s authorisation framework for telecom and satellite services was “fair and non-discriminatory” and that any suggestion that it was being applied selectively was “baseless and misconceived”. Telecom Minister Jyotiraditya Scindia “set the record straight” on Friday, saying that India did not allow a monopoly in any sector, including satcom, and that licences had been given to all three companies — Reliance Jio, OneWeb, and Starlink — that had applied. A fourth entity interested in entering India — Amazon Leo — will also have to go through the same process. Security clearances are being examined by Ministry of Home Affairs, which will also issue the final clearances, he added. Scindia added that the government was holding discussion with the Telecom Regulatory Authority of India on the pricing of satellite spectrum and once all the entities fulfilled or complied with the security conditions, they could start operating.

items.title: Eagles' Jeremiah Trotter Jr., Jags' Bryan Thomas Jr. ejected
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Philadelphia Eagles linebacker Jeremiah Trotter Jr. and Jacksonville Jaguars defensive end Bryan Thomas Jr. were ejected for fighting on the opening kickoff of the teams' game Sunday in London.
items.body:
Philadelphia Eagles linebacker Jeremiah Trotter Jr. and Jacksonville Jaguars defensive end Bryan Thomas Jr. were ejected for fighting on the opening kickoff of the teams' game Sunday in London.
The two players had to be pulled apart at the conclusion of the play, which initially resulted in a 90-yard kickoff return for a touchdown by Jacksonville rookie Josh Cameron. The touchdown, however, was nullified by offsetting penalties, with the Eagles penalized for illegal formation and the Jaguars for holding by linebacker Branson Combs.
During the skirmish, Trotter shoved Thomas to the ground before the latter appeared to attempt to kick the former from that position.
Trotter, 23, is the son of the four-time Pro Bowl player of the same name who spent eight of his 11 NFL season with the Eagles.
Thomas, 22, is an undrafted rookie who was appearing in his fourth career game.
--Field Level Media

items.title: Struggling Corinthians sign Seedorf as manager
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Former Netherlands midfielder Clarence Seedorf has returned to a managerial role after seven years, with Brazilian side Corinthians announcing the 50-year-old as their coach on Sunday.
items.body:
Former Netherlands midfielder Clarence Seedorf has returned to a managerial role after seven years, with Brazilian side Corinthians announcing the 50-year-old as their coach on Sunday.
The former Real Madrid, Inter Milan and AC Milan player had last managed Cameroon, where he was sacked in July 2019.
He has joined Corinthians on a contract until the end of the 2027 season, the club said in a statement.
Corinthians, who are a point above the relegation zone in the Brazilian Serie A, sacked previous manager Fernando Diniz on Wednesday.
Seedorf had terminated his contract with Botafogo to retire as a player and take up his first managerial role at Milan in January 2014.
He took over at Milan when they were 11th, and helped them finish eighth, before being dismissed in June. He later coached Shenzhen and Deportivo La Coruna.
Corinthians visit second-placed Palmeiras later on Sunday.

items.title: Hamilton apologises as pit lane miss costs Ferrari double podium in Singapore
items.author: Rohith Nair
items.creator: Rohith Nair
items.summary: Lewis Hamilton's tire troubles mounted as he struggled to match the race pace.
items.body:
Lewis Hamilton apologised to Ferrari after a failure to enter the pits during a crucial Virtual Safety Car period prevented the Italian team from placing two cars on the podium at Sunday's Singapore Grand Prix.
While there was no catching Red Bull's Max Verstappen, who claimed his [USN:L1N45X03I TEXT:"first win in Singapore from pole"], the two Ferraris were second and third when the VSC was triggered by Lance Stroll's retirement.
Ferrari boss Fred Vasseur revealed both drivers were called in to change tyres, but Hamilton missed the pit entry while Charles Leclerc successfully stopped and eventually claimed second place after overtaking his teammate.
"We all started the race completely blind with the tyres and I think today the soft was much better than the medium. It's why Lewis struggled at the beginning," Vasseur told Sky Sports.
"We kept the door open for the two options depending on VSC and that was the case. We called them both to pit. It would have been P2-P3 because we were P2-P3 on track and he missed the pit entry."
Hamilton's tyre troubles mounted as he struggled to match the race pace, eventually being overtaken by Leclerc, Mercedes' Kimi Antonelli as well as McLaren's Lando Norris and Oscar Piastri to finish a disappointing sixth.
'I MISSED THE ENTRY' The Briton said he had learned a "painful lesson" but took full responsibility for the call to stay out.
"Under the VSC, the team called me in but I missed the entry. After that, I decided to stay out and try to hold track position to the end," Hamilton said.
"But in the closing laps, I was struggling massively with tyre degradation and lost three places, finishing P6, which doesn't reflect the pace we had in the car today.
"Not every call will work out and I can accept getting it wrong, but I'm sorry for the team for the points we lost today."
The dejected seven-times world champion also apologised over the team radio as he brought his car back to the pits after the race.
"Sorry boys, I let you down today with that strategy. My call and I lost us valuable points," Hamilton said.
"I'll try and make up for it in the next one. Great job with the pit stop though."
The missed opportunity was particularly painful given Ferrari's promising pace in Singapore, with Hamilton and Leclerc finishing second and third behind Verstappen in [USN:L1N45W02M TEXT:"Saturday's sprint"].
"Honestly, it's a bit of a shame because he's losing a podium as well," Vasseur said, adding that there was no miscommunication.
"He was crystal clear on the radio. But now let's be focused on Austin. The performance this weekend was okay. We have to be focused on the future."

items.title: Monte dei Paschi to hold board meeting on M&A situation on Monday
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Italy's Banca Monte dei Paschi di Siena will hold a board meeting late on Monday to take stock of the situation after suitor Intesa Sanpaolo pledged to hike its takeover bid and gained the support of some key MPS investors, three people close to the matter said on Sunday.
items.body:
Italy's Banca Monte dei Paschi di Siena (BMPS.MI) will hold a board meeting late on Monday to take stock of the situation after suitor Intesa Sanpaolo (ISP.MI) pledged to hike its takeover bid and gained the support of some key MPS investors, three people close to the matter said on Sunday.
Intesa a week ago said it would increase by 25% the cash component of its [USN:L1N45P04T TEXT:"€35 billion takeover"] bid if MPS shareholders rejected a defence plan CEO Luigi Lovaglio has proposed against the bid.
The board will discuss the latest developments, one of the sources said, adding it was not clear if any further defence moves could be put to board members.
To be able to advance his defence scheme, Lovaglio has called a shareholder vote on it on October 29, where he needs a two-third majority approval. But [USN:L8N45U0BR TEXT:"shareholders"] holding in aggregate some 30% of the bank's capital over the course of the past week said they would not back the project - making it impossible to reach the necessary approval threshold.

items.title: Polícia polonesa detém homem após ameaça ao primeiro-ministro Donald Tusk
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: A polícia polonesa deteve um homem suspeito de planejar um ataque contra o primeiro-ministro Donald Tusk, informou o ministro do Interior no domingo, após ter alertado anteriormente sobre uma ameaça contra Tusk e o ministro da Defesa, Wladyslaw Kosiniak-Kamysz.
items.body:
A polícia polonesa deteve um homem suspeito de planejar um ataque contra o primeiro-ministro Donald Tusk, informou o ministro do Interior no domingo, após ter alertado anteriormente sobre uma ameaça contra Tusk e o ministro da Defesa, Wladyslaw Kosiniak-Kamysz.
“O homem que ameaçou e planejou um ataque contra o primeiro-ministro Donald Tusk foi detido pela polícia polonesa”, escreveu Marcin Kierwinski no X, sem fornecer mais detalhes.
Tusk agradeceu à polícia pela “ação rápida e decisiva” em uma postagem separada no X.
Embora crimes violentos sejam relativamente raros na Polônia, o país está profundamente polarizado politicamente e tem enfrentado ameaças à segurança devido à sua proximidade com a guerra na Ucrânia.
Em agosto, a polícia deteve um homem de 23 anos acusado de incitar o assassinato de políticos poloneses de alto escalão.
Em 2024, Tusk afirmou ter recebido ameaças após uma tentativa de assassinato contra o primeiro-ministro eslovaco Robert Fico.
A porta-voz do Ministério do Interior Karolina Galecka disse no domingo que um email com informações sobre o possível ataque havia sido encaminhado à polícia pelo Serviço de Proteção do Estado, responsável pela segurança dos ministros.

items.title: Quién es quién en la serie de “Timbiriche”: los actores que interpretan a cada integrante
items.author: Isaac Garrido
items.summary: La serie de Vix está inspirada en hecho reales que rodearon a una de las bandas más emblemáticas del pop en español.
items.body: Finalmente, la serie de “Timbiriche” llega a ViX, la plataforma de streaming de TelevisaUnivisión. La producción está inspirada en los hechos reales que rodearon el nacimiento y la evolución de una de las bandas más icónicas del pop en español, que se convirtió en un suceso en toda Latinoamérica entre los 80 y los 90. El estreno de la serie coincide también con el caso de Sasha Sokol, integrante de la alineación original, quien en 2022 denunció públicamente que el productor Luis de Llano había mantenido una relación con ella cuando tenía 14 años y él 39. El caso dio un vuelco histórico cuando la Suprema Corte de Justicia de México determinó que las acciones civiles para reclamar reparación del daño por violencia sexual sufrida durante la infancia no prescriben necesariamente por el paso del tiempo. Timbiriche surgió como una agrupación infantil y, a lo largo de su historia, por sus filas pasaron figuras como Paulina Rubio, Thalía, Benny Ibarra y Erick Rubín, entre muchos otros que se mantienen activos en la industria. Ahora, una nueva generación de actores da vida a los integrantes del grupo en los ocho episodios de la emisión. Osvaldo Benavides, quien también participa como productor, interpreta a Luis de Llano, cuyo apellido no se usa en la historia. Macarena García da vida a Sasha, cuya relación con Luis ocupa un lugar importante en la trama desde los primeros capítulos. “Intento hacer todo con mucho respeto, mucha empatía, entendiendo la responsabilidad tan grande que tenía”, dijo la actriz durante la rueda de prensa. Sebastián Poza interpreta a Benny Ibarra, integrante de la alineación original de Timbiriche y sobrino real de De Llano. Michelle Pellicer, por su parte, encarna a Paulina Rubio. Luis de la Rosa, quien interpretó a Luis Miguel durante su adolescencia en Luis Miguel: La serie , ahora da vida a Erick Rubín. El elenco también incluye a Jesusa Ochoa como Alix, Iker Sánchez como Diego Schoening, Clara Dalmao como Thalía y Edu Maruri como Eduardo Capetillo. Cabe señalar que en la serie varios personajes no utilizan sus apellidos. Además, durante la presentación se mostraron algunas variaciones en los nombres, como el de Paulina Rubio, escrito como “Paulinaa”. A días del estreno del primer episodio en TV abierta, parte de los integrantes originales emitieron un comunicado donde señalaron que no se les consideró en el desarrollo de la serie. “Tampoco autorizamos el uso de nuestra imagen, voz o identidad”, señalaron Alix, Diego, Mariana, Erik, Benny y Sasha. “Existe una enorme diferencia entre inspirarse en una época y construir una ficción alrededor de personas reconocibles y vivas, sin haberlas escuchado ni involucrado”. “Aquí no hay nada legal, simplemente contamos una obra inspirada en la realidad”, dijo Cruz, quien también fue productor de “Luis Miguel, la serie” y de “¿Quién lo mató?”, sobre Paco Stanley. Cruz también destacó que al final de la serie aparece una leyenda donde se explica la evolución del caso de Sasha y De Llano.

items.title: 1 Trump dice que Rusia y Ucrania han alcanzado un alto el fuego energético inmediato
items.author: Daniel Flynn, Steve Holland
items.creator: Daniel Flynn, Steve Holland
items.summary: El presidente de Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, dijo el domingo que Ucrania y Rusia habían acordado lo que él describió como un "alto el fuego energético", horas después de que el líder ucraniano, Volodímir Zelenski, se opuso a la presión de Washington para poner fin de forma unilateral a los ataques contra las refinerías rusas.
items.body:
El presidente de Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, dijo el domingo que Ucrania y Rusia habían acordado lo que él describió como un "alto el fuego energético", horas después de que el líder ucraniano, Volodímir Zelenski, se opuso a la presión de Washington para poner fin de forma unilateral a los ataques contra las refinerías rusas.
En una publicación en redes sociales, Trump dijo que el alto el fuego energético entraría en vigor de inmediato, pero no dio más detalles.
En una entrevista con Axios, Zelenski señaló que la publicación de Trump era la primera vez que oía hablar del acuerdo, aunque un alto cargo ucraniano dijo a Reuters que Ucrania estaba dispuesta a aceptar dicho alto el fuego, si Rusia también lo estaba.
Trump, a quien se ha culpado de que la guerra en Irán haya provocado los altos precios del diésel, ya había anunciado a mediados de septiembre un alto el fuego energético en Ucrania, aunque ninguna de las partes confirmó jamás que se hubiera alcanzado.
"Con efecto inmediato, hay un ALTO EL FUEGO ENERGÉTICO en la guerra entre Rusia y Ucrania. Ambas partes han dado su consentimiento. ¡No lo rompáis!", escribió Trump en Truth Social.
El domingo por la mañana, Zelenski había reiterado la postura anterior de Ucrania: que está dispuesta a detener los ataques contra las refinerías rusas, pero solo si Moscú cesa sus propios ataques contra la infraestructura energética ucraniana.
Cualquier acuerdo de este tipo tendría que ir acompañado de "garantías reales", dijo Zelenski.
"La verdadera causa de la guerra en Europa es Rusia y solo Rusia", agregó Zelenski. "Es posible detener los ataques contra las infraestructuras energéticas ya desde hoy mismo, pero Putin no quiere hacerlo".
En un dramático deterioro de sus relaciones, Trump había advertido el sábado a Zelenski de que "más le valía dejar de una vez" de atacar las refinerías rusas, y había instado a los ucranianos a sustituirlo como líder mediante nuevas elecciones, ya que había desaprovechado varias oportunidades para llegar a un acuerdo con Moscú.
En su intervención del domingo en el programa "This Week" de la ABC, Zelenski respondió que organizaría elecciones en Ucrania si el presidente ruso, Vladímir Putin, aceptaba un alto el fuego de 60 días.
El líder ucraniano rechazó que se le culpara de las subidas de los precios de la energía, y añadió que "todo el mundo" sabía que la guerra en Oriente Medio era un factor más importante.
La fuerte subida de los precios mundiales del diésel, que siguió al estallido de la guerra en Irán en febrero, se ha convertido en un lastre político para el Partido Republicano de Trump antes de las elecciones legislativas, en las que los demócratas de la oposición podrían hacerse con el control de una o ambas cámaras del Congreso.
Los analistas han dicho que es poco probable que el acuerdo de suministro de gasóleo de Trump con Moscú provoque una baja sostenida de los precios del combustible, ya que los volúmenes implicados eran pocos.
El acuerdo sobre el gasóleo también fue criticado por legisladores estadounidenses, entre ellos uno de los compañeros republicanos de Trump, el diputado Don Bacon, quien sostuvo que era el momento de aplicar más sanciones, no de levantarlas.

items.title: Verstappen, de Red Bull, se alza con su primera victoria en el Gran Premio de Singapur
items.author: Rohith Nair
items.creator: Rohith Nair
items.summary: Max Verstappen, de Red Bull, tuvo un desempeño dominante el domingo desde la pole position en el Gran Premio de Singapur, que le valió su segunda victoria consecutiva de la temporada tras un fin de semana perfecto en el que también se impuso en la carrera al "sprint".
items.body:
Max Verstappen, de Red Bull, tuvo un desempeño dominante el domingo desde la pole position en el Gran Premio de Singapur, que le valió su segunda victoria consecutiva de la temporada tras un fin de semana perfecto en el que también se impuso en la carrera al "sprint".
El holandés controló la carrera desde el inicio en el Circuito Urbano de Marina Bay, resistiendo un ataque inicial de Charles Leclerc, de Ferrari, que terminó segundo, mientras que Kimi Antonelli, de Mercedes, se hizo con el último puesto del podio.
Verstappen, que ganó el Gran Premio de Baréin en Malasia el pasado fin de semana, nunca había ganado antes en Singapur y había llegado al fin de semana de carrera afirmando que tenía "asuntos pendientes".
"Ha llevado su tiempo, pero creo que esta carrera ha sido muy buena. Teníamos ritmo cuando lo necesitábamos con los neumáticos blandos, aunque creo que los neumáticos medios nos dieron más problemas a todos", dijo Verstappen.
"Pero ha salido bien, así que, por supuesto, estoy muy contento de ganar aquí (...) Las dos últimas carreras han sido muy positivas para nosotros y es fantástico verlo".
Antonelli amplió su ventaja en el campeonato sobre su compañero de equipo George Russell a 102 puntos y el italiano puede proclamarse matemáticamente campeón en la próxima prueba, en Austin.
"¿Puedo? ¿De verdad?", dijo Antonelli, sorprendido, cuando se lo comunicaron tras su decimocuarto podio de la temporada.
"Bueno, no nos preocupemos por eso. Intentemos hacer el mejor fin de semana posible y rematar la faena".
Lewis Hamilton, de Ferrari, había conseguido la tercera posición en la parrilla de salida, pero vivió una tarde complicada, cayendo hasta la sexta posición por detrás de Lando Norris y Oscar Piastri después de que los dos pilotos de McLaren le adelantaron en los últimos compases de la carrera, mientras él luchaba con problemas de neumáticos.

items.title: Verstappen vence GP de Cingapura de F1 e Antonelli se aproxima do título
items.author: Rohith Nair
items.creator: Rohith Nair
items.summary: Max Verstappen, da Red Bull, teve um desempenho dominante e venceu o Grande Prêmio de Cingapura largando da pole position no domingo, garantindo sua segunda vitória consecutiva na temporada da Fórmula 1 após um fim de semana perfeito, que incluiu uma vitória na corrida sprint.
items.body:
Max Verstappen, da Red Bull, teve um desempenho dominante e venceu o Grande Prêmio de Cingapura largando da pole position no domingo, garantindo sua segunda vitória consecutiva na temporada da Fórmula 1 após um fim de semana perfeito, que incluiu uma vitória na corrida sprint.
O holandês controlou a corrida desde o início no Circuito de Rua de Marina Bay, resistindo a um ataque inicial de Charles Leclerc, da Ferrari, que terminou em segundo, enquanto Kimi Antonelli, da Mercedes, ficou em terceiro, aproximando-se do seu primeiro título.
Verstappen, que venceu o Grande Prêmio do Barein na Malásia no fim de semana passado, nunca havia vencido em Cingapura antes e chegou ao fim de semana de corrida afirmando que tinha “uma conta a acertar”.
"Levou um tempo, mas acho que esta corrida foi muito boa. Tivemos ritmo quando precisávamos com os pneus macios, embora eu ache que os pneus médios tenham sido mais difíceis para todo mundo", disse Verstappen.
“Mas deu certo, então é claro que estou muito feliz por vencer aqui... As duas últimas corridas foram realmente positivas para nós e é simplesmente ótimo ver isso.”
Antonelli ampliou sua liderança no campeonato sobre o companheiro de equipe George Russell para 102 pontos, e o italiano pode, matematicamente, conquistar o título na próxima etapa, em Austin.
“Será mesmo? Sério?”, disse Antonelli, surpreso, quando foi informado disso após seu 14º pódio da temporada.
“Bem, não vamos nos preocupar com isso. Vamos tentar fazer o melhor fim de semana possível e concluir o trabalho.”
Lewis Hamilton, da Ferrari, havia se classificado em terceiro no grid, mas passou por uma prova difícil, caindo para o sexto lugar atrás de Lando Norris e Oscar Piastri depois que os dois pilotos da McLaren o ultrapassaram nas últimas voltas, enquanto ele enfrentava problemas com os pneus.
Russell, que largou na parte de trás do grid devido a penalidades relacionadas ao motor, terminou em nono, atrás de Liam Lawson e Nico Hulkenberg, enquanto Isack Hadjar — que também largou na parte de trás — ficou em 10º.

items.title: Feysa holds off Lokedi to win Chicago Marathon, Kipruto triumphs in men's race
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Ethiopian Hawi Feysa retained her Chicago Marathon crown in a heavyweight clash with Kenya's Sharon Lokedi on Sunday, breaking the tape in two hours, 13 minutes and 33 seconds, while Kenya's Amos Kipruto dominated the men's race in 2:01:09.
items.body:
Ethiopian Hawi Feysa retained her Chicago Marathon crown in a heavyweight clash with Kenya's Sharon Lokedi on Sunday, breaking the tape in two hours, 13 minutes and 33 seconds, while Kenya's Amos Kipruto dominated the men's race in 2:01:09.
The back-to-back Boston winner Lokedi (2:14:07) battled with Feysa through much of the final six miles of the course but could not hang on as the Ethiopian slammed her foot on the gas in the final mile.
Kenya's Brigid Kosgei was third in 2:14:55.
Lokedi and Feysa pulled away from the lead pack around the 30-kilometre mark, taking advantage of pristine conditions on the famously speedy course, before engaging in a tense cat-and-mouse battle that saw them trade the lead on multiple occasions from there.
Feysa, who picked up her second bronze finish in Tokyo earlier this year, crumpled after crossing the line, telling a TV reporter she was "elated" with her successful title defence.
"It certainly became quite a battle (around 33 kilometres)," she said via a translator. "Around 35k I became pretty sure I had this in the bag."
Kipruto exacted revenge in the men's race after his second-place finish a year ago, adding another marathon major title following his London win four years ago.
Kipruto finished 91 seconds behind Ugandan Jacob Kiplimo in 2025 but flipped the script this time around, running all by himself through the final straight after a tactically flawless performance.
Ethiopian Tadese Bikila crossed the line in 2:02:56 while his compatriot Milkesa Mengesha (2:03:46) was third.
Kipruto and Kiplimo (2:04:18) were leading the field by 16 seconds at 30-kilometre mark but the Ugandan fell off the pace shortly after, slipping to fourth as the Kenya cruised through much of the last chunk of the course alone.
"I was here to fight," said Kipruto. Everything is all about the mindset. It was a tough field but I set my mind on it, I said 'Let's go.'"
Switzerland's Catherine Debrunner shattered her own women's wheelchair world record, breaking the tape in 1:33:16 to knock a minute off the previous mark she set in Berlin three years ago. Oct 11 : Ethiopian Hawi Feysa retained her Chicago Marathon crown in a heavyweight clash with Kenya's Sharon Lokedi on Sunday, breaking the tape in two hours, 13 minutes and 33 seconds, while Kenya's Amos Kipruto dominated the men's race in 2:01:09.
The back-to-back Boston winner Lokedi (2:14:07) battled with Feysa through much of the final six miles of the course but could not hang on as the Ethiopian slammed her foot on the gas in the final mile. 
Kenya's Brigid Kosgei was third in 2:14:55.
Lokedi and Feysa pulled away from the lead pack around the 30-kilometre mark, taking advantage of pristine conditions on the famously speedy course, before engaging in a tense cat-and-mouse battle that saw them trade the lead on multiple occasions from there.

Feysa, who picked up her second bronze finish in Tokyo earlier this year, crumpled after crossing the line, telling a TV reporter she was "elated" with her successful title defence. 
"It certainly became quite a battle (around 33 kilometres)," she said via a translator. "Around 35k I became pretty sure I had this in the bag."
Kipruto exacted revenge in the men's race after his second-place finish a year ago, adding another marathon major title following his London win four years ago.
Kipruto finished 91 seconds behind Ugandan Jacob Kiplimo in 2025 but flipped the script this time around, running all by himself through the final straight after a tactically flawless performance.
Ethiopian Tadese Bikila crossed the line in 2:02:56 while his compatriot Milkesa Mengesha (2:03:46) was third.
Kipruto and Kiplimo (2:04:18) were leading the field by 16 seconds at 30-kilometre mark but the Ugandan fell off the pace shortly after, slipping to fourth as the Kenya cruised through much of the last chunk of the course alone.
"I was here to fight," said Kipruto. Everything is all about the mindset. It was a tough field but I set my mind on it, I said 'Let's go.'"
Switzerland's Catherine Debrunner shattered her own women's wheelchair world record, breaking the tape in 1:33:16 to knock a minute off the previous mark she set in Berlin three years ago. Her compatriot Marcel Hug collected his seventh Chicago Marathon win in the men's wheelchair race in a course record 1:21:34.
"The crowd definitely helped me so much," said Debrunner. "I'm pretty speechless, to be honest, I had no expected to make a world record here at all."

items.title: Papa Leão anuncia que será submetido a cirurgia para remover pequeno nódulo no pulmão
items.author: Joshua McElwee
items.creator: Joshua McElwee
items.summary: O papa Leão afirmou no domingo que médicos detectaram um pequeno nódulo em seu pulmão durante um exame médico recente e que ele será submetido a uma cirurgia nesta semana para removê-lo, no primeiro susto relacionado à saúde do pontífice de 71 anos durante seu pontificado.
items.body:
O papa Leão afirmou no domingo que médicos detectaram um pequeno nódulo em seu pulmão durante um exame médico recente e que ele será submetido a uma cirurgia nesta semana para removê-lo, no primeiro susto relacionado à saúde do pontífice de 71 anos durante seu pontificado.
Leão disse aos peregrinos na Praça de São Pedro, durante sua oração dominical semanal, que o nódulo é “bem delimitado” e havia sido detectado precocemente.
O Vaticano não informou se acredita-se que o nódulo seja maligno.
“Recentemente, durante alguns exames médicos, os médicos encontraram um nódulo localizado no meu pulmão”, disse o pontífice. “Ele foi detectado em um estágio muito inicial e está bem contido.”
“Os médicos acreditam que é aconselhável intervir; portanto, seguindo suas recomendações, decidi me submeter a uma cirurgia para removê-lo”, declarou ele. “A operação já está marcada para os próximos dias.”
Um nódulo no pulmão é uma pequena lesão localizada que pode ser benigna. A Sociedade Torácica Americana afirma que menos de 5% dos nódulos pulmonares, em geral, se revelam cancerosos, embora o risco aumente com a idade, o tamanho e outros fatores, como o tabagismo.
“Nódulos pulmonares são bastante comuns e costumam ser benignos”, disse Stephen Liu, especialista em câncer de pulmão da Universidade de Georgetown, em Washington, e chefe da divisão de hematologia-oncologia do MedStar Georgetown University Hospital.
“Quando há motivo suficiente para preocupação e quando é seguro fazê-lo, com base na localização do nódulo e no estado geral de saúde do paciente, a remoção cirúrgica pode fornecer um diagnóstico definitivo”, afirmou ele.
Leão, eleito papa pelos cardeais de todo o mundo em maio de 2025, é relativamente jovem para um líder da Igreja. Ele gosta de praticar esportes, incluindo tênis, e não é conhecido por ser fumante nem por ter tido problemas de saúde anteriormente.
A primeira-ministra italiana, Giorgia Meloni, desejou melhoras ao papa.
“Gostaria de expressar ao Santo Padre meu apoio pessoal, e o do governo italiano, enquanto ele enfrenta esse desafio nos próximos dias”, disse ela em um comunicado.
“A serenidade e a compostura com que ele falou sobre isso (hoje)... são tranquilizadoras”, acrescentou Meloni.
O papa Francisco, predecessor de Leão, morreu aos 88 anos. Ele foi hospitalizado várias vezes à medida que sua saúde se tornava mais frágil nos últimos anos. Ele geralmente não anunciava suas internações com antecedência, o que às vezes provocava um frenesi da mídia em relação à sua saúde.
A assessoria de imprensa do Vaticano informou que a recuperação de Leão após a cirurgia deve levar cerca de uma semana. Não foram fornecidos imediatamente mais detalhes sobre a saúde do papa.

items.title: L'AIE appelle à envisager un nouveau recours aux stocks stratégiques
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Le directeur exécutif de l'Agence internationale de l'énergie (AIE), Fatih Birol, a proposé dimanche que tous les pays membres réfléchissent à la nécessité de procéder à des libérations supplémentaires des stocks de diesel et en définissent l'ampleur, le calendrier et le caractère complémentaire.
items.body:
Le directeur exécutif de l'Agence internationale de l'énergie (AIE), Fatih Birol, a proposé dimanche que tous les pays membres réfléchissent à la nécessité de procéder à des libérations supplémentaires des stocks de diesel et en définissent l'ampleur, le calendrier et le caractère complémentaire.
Cette suggestion intervient alors que les gouvernements sont confrontés à des prix records du carburant et aux perturbations de l'approvisionnement provoquées par la guerre avec l'Iran.
L'agence, qui coordonne les stocks stratégiques d'urgence de pétrole des pays industrialisés, a également proposé que les pays membres n'ayant pas encore livré l'intégralité des volumes promis accélèrent leurs libérations restantes en privilégiant le diesel, avant une réunion du conseil de direction de l'AIE prévue le 15 octobre.
Les dirigeants du G7 sont convenus debut octobre de libérer leurs réserves stratégiques de produits pétroliers "jusqu'à 100 millions de barils, sous 4 mois" face à la crise énergétique mondiale, peut-on lire dans un communiqué.

items.title: La France appelle les autorités palestiniennes à revenir sur le report les élections
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: La France regrette le report par le président palestinien Mahmoud Abbas des élections législatives et présidentielle, a déclaré dimanche un porte-parole du ministère des Affaires étrangères, appelant les autorités palestiniennes à revenir sur cette décision.
items.body:
La France regrette le report par le président palestinien Mahmoud Abbas des élections législatives et présidentielle, a déclaré dimanche un porte-parole du ministère des Affaires étrangères, appelant les autorités palestiniennes à revenir sur cette décision.
Mahmoud Abbas [USN:L8N45W02B TEXT:"a reporté"] samedi les élections législatives prévues le mois prochain au 11 septembre 2027 et a convoqué un scrutin présidentiel à la même date, mettant cette décision sur le compte d'Israël et de la situation sécuritaire dans les territoires palestiniens.
"Vingt ans après le dernier scrutin national en Palestine, cinq ans après le report des élections législatives prévues en 2021, cette décision prive à nouveau le peuple palestinien du droit de s'exprimer démocratiquement par les urnes", a déploré le porte-parole du Quai d'Orsay dans un communiqué.
Paris "appelle les autorités palestiniennes à revenir sur leur décision et à organiser au plus vite des élections législatives et présidentielles dans l'ensemble de la Palestine", a-t-il ajouté.
La France "est prête, en lien avec ses partenaires européens, à accompagner le bon déroulement de ce processus, y compris dans le cadre de la mission d'observation électorale de l'Union européenne qui a été lancée à sa demande", a également indiqué le ministère des Affaires étrangères.

items.title: Pologne-Un homme arrêté après des menaces visant le Premier ministre
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: La police polonaise a interpellé un homme soupçonné d'avoir préparé une attaque contre le Premier ministre Donald Tusk, a annoncé dimanche le ministre de l'Intérieur, après avoir fait état de menaces visant Donald Tusk et le ministre de la Défense Wladyslaw Kosiniak-Kamysz.
items.body:
La police polonaise a interpellé un homme soupçonné d'avoir préparé une attaque contre le Premier ministre Donald Tusk, a annoncé dimanche le ministre de l'Intérieur, après avoir fait état de menaces visant Donald Tusk et le ministre de la Défense Wladyslaw Kosiniak-Kamysz.
"L'homme qui a proféré des menaces et préparé une attaque contre le Premier ministre Donald Tusk a été arrêté par la police polonaise", a écrit Marcin Kierwinski sur X, sans plus de précisions.
Donald Tusk, dans un message également publié sur X, a remercié la police pour sa "réaction rapide et déterminée".
Si les crimes violents sont relativement rares en Pologne, le pays est profondément polarisé sur le plan politique et est confronté à des menaces sécuritaires en raison de sa proximité avec la guerre en Ukraine.
En août, la police a interpellé un homme de 23 ans accusé d'avoir appelé à l'assassinat de hauts responsables politiques polonais.
En 2024, Donald Tusk avait déclaré avoir reçu des menaces après une tentative d'assassinat du Premier ministre slovaque Robert Fico.
La porte-parole du ministère de l'Intérieur, Karolina Galecka, a indiqué dimanche qu'un courriel contenant des informations sur une éventuelle attaque avait été transmis à la police par le Service de protection de l'État, chargé de la sécurité des ministres.

items.summary: Kenya has not recorded any new cases of Ebola after conducting 293 tests since a positive patient died on October 5, the Ministry of Health said on Sunday.
items.body:
Kenya has not recorded any new cases of Ebola after conducting 293 tests since a positive patient died on October 5, the Ministry of Health said on Sunday.
The country confirmed its first [USN:L8N45S0GY TEXT:"imported"] case of Ebola on October 6 after a citizen who travelled from the Democratic Republic of Congo died of the virus in Kenya's capital, Nairobi.
Tests were conducted on 293 samples from 289 alerts and only the confirmed case was positive, the Ministry of Health said in a statement
In addition, 108 of the 122 listed contacts of patient-zero are in quarantine and have not developed symptoms
The ministry said it was appealing to the public to stay calm but vigilant, and requested anyone who had concerns about possible exposure or was presenting symptoms to seek medical care
Kenya is the fourth country to record a case linked to the Ebola epidemic in eastern Congo, the [USN:L1N45O094 TEXT:"second-largest"] on record with more than 8,000 cases

items.title: Los servicios de seguridad polacos se reúnen tras una "grave" amenaza contra el primer ministro
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Los servicios de seguridad polacos convocaron una reunión extraordinaria el domingo tras recibir información sobre un posible atentado contra el primer ministro Donald Tusk y el ministro de Defensa Wladyslaw Kosiniak-Kamysz, informó un portavoz.
items.body:
Los servicios de seguridad polacos convocaron una reunión extraordinaria el domingo tras recibir información sobre un posible atentado contra el primer ministro Donald Tusk y el ministro de Defensa Wladyslaw Kosiniak-Kamysz, informó un portavoz.
El portavoz de los servicios especiales, Jacek Dobrzynski, dijo que no podía entrar en detalles, pero que las autoridades se tomaban la amenaza "con la máxima seriedad".
"Estamos hablando de una alta probabilidad de que estas amenazas se lleven a cabo", dijo a periodistas.
La portavoz del Ministerio del Interior, Karolina Galecka, explicó que el Servicio de Protección del Estado, responsable de la seguridad de los ministros, había remitido a la policía un correo electrónico con información sobre el posible atentado.
Si bien los delitos violentos son relativamente poco frecuentes en Polonia, el país está profundamente polarizado políticamente y se ha enfrentado a amenazas para la seguridad debido a su proximidad a la guerra en Ucrania.
En agosto, la policía detuvo a un hombre de 23 años acusado de incitar al asesinato de altos cargos políticos polacos.
En 2024, Tusk dijo haber recibido amenazas tras un intento de asesinato contra el primer ministro eslovaco, Robert Fico.

items.summary: "Please tell Putin, give us two months," Zelenskiy told ABC's "This Week."
items.body:
Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy said on Sunday in response to critical comments from US President Donald Trump that he will organize elections in Ukraine if Russian President Vladimir Putin agrees to a 60-day ceasefire.
"Please tell Putin, give us two months, 60 days of total ceasefire, 60 days, and we will organize elections," Zelenskiy told ABC's "This Week."
Trump on Saturday criticized Zelenskiy for attacking Russian oil refineries a day after the US temporarily lifted sanctions on Russian fuel that were designed to deprive Moscow of revenues to fund its war in Ukraine .
"I think it's time for Ukraine to get a new president," Trump had told reporters at the White House.
In response, Zelenskiy said "it's up to Ukrainians" to choose their leader and noted that Putin would also like to change who is leading Ukraine.
He said it is easy for Ukraine to be blamed for higher fuel prices "when everybody in the world understands because of the war in (the) Middle East , the prices are rising."
Earlier on Sunday, Zelenskiy said Ukraine was [USN:L1N45X021 TEXT:"ready to halt"] attacks on Russian oil refineries if Moscow ceases its own strikes on Ukrainian energy infrastructure.
Under terms of the deal as described by Trump on Friday, Russia will immediately supply more than 300,000 metric tons of diesel to US and global markets, equal to about 2.25 million barrels of fuel. The US exports about 1.5 million barrels of diesel per day.
Trump is under pressure to bring down rising fuel prices ahead of November midterm elections that will determine whether his Republican Party will retain control of the US Congress for his final two years in office.
Many lawmakers, including Republicans, have criticized the diesel deal as rewarding Putin.

items.title: Verstappen cruises to first Singapore GP win as Antonelli closes on crown
items.author: Rohith Nair
items.creator: Rohith Nair
items.summary: It was Max Verstappen's first win in Singapore.
items.body:
Red Bull's Max Verstappen delivered a commanding performance to win the Singapore Grand Prix from pole position on Sunday, securing his second straight victory of the season after a perfect weekend that included a [USN:L1N45W02M TEXT:"sprint race triumph"].
The Dutchman controlled the race from the start at the Marina Bay Street Circuit, fending off an early challenge from Ferrari's Charles Leclerc who finished second while Mercedes' Kimi Antonelli was third to close in on a first title.
Verstappen, who won the Bahrain Grand Prix in Malaysia last weekend, had never won in Singapore before and he had come into the race weekend stating he had "unfinished business".
"It's taken a while but I think this race was very good. We had pace when we needed to have it on the soft tyre, even though I think the medium tyre for everyone was more of a struggle," Verstappen said.
"But it worked out, so of course very happy to win here... The last two races have been really positive for us and it's just great to see."
Antonelli extended his championship lead over teammate George Russell to 102 points and the Italian can mathematically win the title in the next round in Austin.
"Can I? Really?" a surprised Antonelli said when he was told after his 14th podium of the season.
"Well, let's not worry about that. Let's try to do the best weekend as possible and finish the job."
Ferrari's Lewis Hamilton had qualified third on the grid but he endured a torrid evening, slipping to sixth behind Lando Norris and Oscar Piastri after the two McLaren drivers overtook him in the dying stages as he struggled with his tyres.
Russell, who started at the back of the grid due to engine penalties, finished ninth behind Liam Lawson and Nico Hulkenberg while Isack Hadjar - who also started at the back - was 10th.
VERSTAPPEN SHUTS THE DOOR Leclerc reacted faster than polesitter Verstappen at the start, nearly lining up alongside the Dutchman heading into turn one, but the Red Bull driver veered to the left to shut the door on the Ferrari and retain his lead.
As the race progressed, Verstappen steadily pulled clear on soft tyres, with Red Bull urging him to manage their life as Ferrari threatened an undercut.
Hamilton's struggles became apparent early as he lost pace on medium tyres in third place and Ferrari brought him in for softs before Leclerc pitted on lap 25 in a move timed to emerge ahead of his teammate.
Hamilton's frustration boiled over on team radio as he urged Ferrari to let him past Leclerc, saying: "I need to use this speed, mate," before Leclerc responded by setting the fastest lap.
When Verstappen finally pitted on lap 33, his commanding lead allowed him to rejoin in first place.
Lance Stroll's retirement with clutch issues triggered another VSC period that sparked a flurry of pit stops and Russell's timing proved unfortunate as the VSC ended earlier than expected, dropping him to 10th.
RADIO ISSUES FOR VERSTAPPEN The strategy chaos benefited Leclerc, who caught and passed Hamilton on lap 46 to claim second place, though he remained nearly 15 seconds behind Verstappen, who faced radio communication problems for the second time this weekend.
The issue forced his engineer to resort to coded messages, asking the Dutchman to key his mic to make a sound or stay silent when given options on strategy.
The final stint saw Hamilton's pace collapse as multiple drivers closed in sensing a podium.
Norris attempted to pass Hamilton on lap 54, but the Ferrari left the track and went wide while the McLaren went on the dirty part of the track, allowing Antonelli to overtake and move up to fourth.
Antonelli then passed Hamilton for third before Norris found his opportunity at turn 10.
Hamilton's misery was completed when Piastri overtook him on the final lap, relegating the Ferrari driver to sixth place.

items.title: Volkswagen CEO says transformation is 'shared responsibility' in appeal to EU
items.author: Rachel More
items.creator: Rachel More
items.summary: In his speech at the Paris auto show, Oliver Blume backed proposed "Made in Europe" rules and welcomed an EU-China deal that could cut Chinese imports of plug-in hybrid vehicles to the bloc by more than half.
items.body:
Volkswagen chief Oliver Blume expects European policymakers to create the framework needed to make the German automaker's restructuring a success, he said on Sunday, amid a push by Brussels to shield industry from low-cost Chinese competitors.
At an event titled "For Europe" on the eve of the Paris motor show, Blume said Volkswagen was working to reduce complexity across the company, whose brands range from mass-market VW to high-end marques like Porsche and Lamborghini, in what he called "the biggest transformation programme in our history".
"This is a shared responsibility: The business community must become more competitive and create attractive opportunities, while policymakers must establish the right framework conditions," he said.
PRICE WAR IN ELECTRIC VEHICLES The auto show in Paris comes at a critical juncture for Europe's top carmaker, which is undergoing a major restructuring and is racing to update its mass-market electric vehicle offering as Chinese competitors rapidly gain ground in Europe.
Battered by an EV price war and falling sales at home, Chinese automakers are aggressively expanding into Europe.
In his speech, Blume backed proposed "Made in Europe" rules to incentivise local manufacturing, and welcomed [USN:L6N45V0LF TEXT:"a deal"] between the EU and China that could cut Chinese imports of plug-in hybrid vehicles to the bloc by more than half.
"Those who sell here should compete under comparable conditions and create jobs and value here in Europe too," Blume said at the event, attended by France's minister for industry Sebastien Martin.
Battling to implement sweeping job cuts and threatening to close up to four plants in Germany, Blume also faces pressure from investors to prove his [USN:L8N44W0B8 TEXT:"turnaround strategy"] goes beyond downsizing to make strides in product development and software.
A suite of affordable EVs across Volkswagen's volume brands, including VW, Spain's Cupra and the Czech Republic's Skoda, will be on show at the event.
Volkswagen will also premiere its new ID. Tiguan electric SUV.
Volkswagen is by far Europe's top-selling automaker, with a consistent market share of roughly a quarter over the last decade, even as Chinese entrants like BYD (002594.SZ) and Leapmotor (9863.HK) build a following.
Still, Volkswagen is feeling the heat. Its CEO is among German auto industry leaders [USN:L8N44O0MW TEXT:"calling for"] a more protectionist EU stance, as fears of retaliation from Beijing give way to worries that brutal competition in China has spread to Europe.
EUROPEAN MARKET 'COULD BECOME VERY UNPROFITABLE' Gregor Williams, an analyst at Rhodium Group, said: "Industry has become a lot more concerned about the competitive challenge arising in China."
The downturn in China's domestic auto market is creating export pressure, Williams said.
"It's one thing to lose revenues," he added. "But if China also manages to export the price war, the European market could become very unprofitable."

items.title: Zheng overpowers Andreeva to win China Open
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Olympic champion Zheng Qinwen became the first Chinese player to win the China Open.
items.body:
Olympic champion Zheng Qinwen became the first Chinese player to win the China Open, beating French Open winner Mirra Andreeva 7-5 6-4 on Sunday.
Wildcard Zheng, who has been on a recovery path after missing much of last year and early 2026 due to an elbow injury on her dominant right arm, looked like her old self as she used powerful forehands to control the rallies, and landed swift winners angling away from Andreeva.
"The feeling was incredible to win here in Beijing... it's one of my dreams," said 24-year-old Zheng, whose China Open campaign ended in a heartbreak last year as she was forced to retire after aggravating her injury.
After the two exchanged early breaks, world number five Andreeva held firm to go 5-4 up, and almost got a decisive break when world number 54 Zheng sent a cross-court shot too long before netting a forehand.
However, Zheng, saved three break points to make it 5-5, and pounced on an error-prone Andreeva in the next game, outwitting the Russian with a swift backhand to get the break that secured the first set.
Andreeva saved three break points as the second set was poised at 4-4, but a persistent Zheng got the break, and landed a perfect ace in the next game to clinch her first WTA 1000 title, and her first trophy of the year.
Zheng and Andreeva are set to compete at the Wuhan Open starting Monday, with US Open quarter-finalist Zheng eyeing a return to the top 20 in the rankings if she can carry the momentum into the next tournament.

items.body:
El director ejecutivo de la Agencia Internacional de la Energía (AIE), Fatih Birol, sugirió el domingo que todos los miembros evalúen si es necesario realizar más liberaciones diésel y que determinen su alcance, calendario y carácter complementario, en un momento en que los Gobiernos tratan de hacer frente a los precios récord del combustible y a las interrupciones en el suministro provocadas por la guerra de Irán.
La agencia, que coordina las reservas de petróleo de emergencia entre los países industrializados, también sugirió que los países miembros que aún no hayan entregado íntegramente los volúmenes prometidos aceleren las liberaciones pendientes, dando prioridad al diésel, antes de la reunión del consejo de administración de la AIE prevista para el 15 de octubre.

items.title: Nuevo ataque contra aeropuerto de Riad provoca incendio, un día después de otro en que murieron 12
items.author: Jana Choukeir, Maha Dahan, Timour Azhari
items.creator: Jana Choukeir, Maha Dahan, Timour Azhari
items.summary: La coalición liderada por Arabia Saudita en Yemen dijo que un "proyectil no identificado" había impactado el domingo en el aeropuerto internacional de Riad, provocando un incendio, pocas horas después de que los hutíes, respaldados por Irán, advirtieron a las compañías aéreas y a los viajeros que se mantuvieran alejados de los aeropuertos sauditas .
items.body:
La coalición liderada por Arabia Saudita en Yemen dijo que un "proyectil no identificado" había impactado el domingo en el aeropuerto internacional de Riad, provocando un incendio, pocas horas después de que los hutíes, respaldados por Irán, advirtieron a las compañías aéreas y a los viajeros que se mantuvieran alejados de los aeropuertos sauditas .
La coalición también dijo que las defensas aéreas sauditas habían interceptado un misil de crucero en las inmediaciones del Aeropuerto Internacional Rey Khalid. No se facilitaron más detalles de inmediato.
El aeropuerto permanece cerrado tras el ataque del sábado, en el que murieron 12 personas y más de 300 resultaron heridas, el ataque más mortífero de este tipo contra el reino en más de una década, en un contexto de una escalada de los combates entre los hutíes y las fuerzas gubernamentales yemeníes.
A pesar del cierre temporal del aeropuerto, el Ministerio de Energía saudita dijo que una conferencia internacional sobre energía, prevista desde hacía tiempo, seguiría celebrándose en Riad el domingo.
La coalición liderada por Arabia Saudita en Yemen informó de que el proyectil del domingo tenía como objetivo la Terminal 4 del aeropuerto, sin dar más detalles.
"Reiteramos nuestra advertencia a todas las compañías aéreas, expertos, empleados, trabajadores y viajeros para que no usen los aeropuertos ni el espacio aéreo sauditas, ya que son vulnerables a los ataques y se han convertido en un teatro de operaciones para nuestras fuerzas, con la excepción de los aeropuertos de (las ciudades santas de) La Meca y Medina", habían dicho antes los hutíes en una publicación en X.
Arabia Saudita ha intensificado su intervención militar en Yemen en las últimas semanas, lanzando ataques contra los hutíes y respaldando una contraofensiva del Gobierno yemení después de que el grupo respaldado por Irán se hizo con territorio estratégico en la costa del mar Rojo el mes pasado.
El Ministerio de Asuntos Exteriores de Yemen, controlado por los hutíes, dijo el domingo que cualquier nueva acción militar saudita en Yemen provocaría una respuesta más contundente, y añadió que sus acciones se regirían por el principio de reciprocidad.

items.title: Germany backs Ukraine's Zelenskiy after Trump's call for his removal
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: German Foreign Minister Johann Wadephul restated Berlin's support for Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy on Sunday following US President Donald Trump's call for his removal and urged more pressure to be put on Russia to resume peace talks.
items.body:
German Foreign Minister Johann Wadephul restated Berlin's support for Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy on Sunday following US President Donald Trump's call for his removal and urged more pressure to be put on Russia to resume peace talks.
Wadephul said Germany remained by the side of Ukraine and its government "and fully support the President as he carries out his difficult duties."
The comments, at a leadership meeting of Chancellor Friedrich Merz's conservative Christian Democrats (CDU), followed Trump's call on Saturday for Zelenskiy to be replaced and underlined Berlin's growing rift with Washington.
Trump, who last week announced a diesel supply deal with Russia, called for Ukraine to [USN:L6N45W06G TEXT:"replace Zelenskiy"] and railed against Ukraine's attacks on Russian oil infrastructure.
Germany, the biggest European donor to Ukraine, said on Saturday it would [USN:L1N45W02N TEXT:"maintain sanctions"] against Russia despite Trump's announcement that his administration had temporarily lifted US sanctions on Russian fuel.
Wadephul, who met his Russian counterpart Sergei Lavrov on the margins of the United Nations General Assembly in New York last month, said "consistency and clarity" were needed to support Ukraine and bring Moscow to negotiate.
"We don't need less pressure, we need more pressure on Putin to make him be ready to negotiate," Wadephul said. "That is what this moment requires and that's what the government stands for."
British Prime Minister Andy Burnham spoke with Zelenskiy [USN:FWN45V15A TEXT:"on Saturday"] and told him the UK would continue to strengthen its sanctions on Russia, a Downing Street spokesperson said.

items.title: Deutsche Bank chief warns German election results worrying foreign investors
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: The head of Germany's largest bank warned that foreign investors may be driven away following victories in state elections last month by parties on the political extremes.
items.body:
The head of Germany's largest bank warned that foreign investors may be driven away following victories in state elections last month by parties on the political extremes.
The AfD, which wants to restrict immigration and send asylum seekers home, scored some of its biggest-ever wins in eastern Germany last month. At the same time, the Left Party scored its biggest win in the election for the city government of Berlin, pledging to [USN:L1N45C05W TEXT:"expropriate holdings"] of property companies.
"This poses a significant risk to Germany, and it should not be played down," Christian Sewing, chief executive of Deutsche Bank (DBKGn.DE) , told the Bild daily in an interview, referring to the rise of political extremes.
"You can't expect a foreign investor to immediately draw a distinction between a state government and Germany as a whole," he said. "It's seen as Germany as a whole and I think that from an investor's point of view, that's understandable."
In the state of Saxony-Anhalt, the AfD, which is classified by security services as extremist in some regions, only narrowly fell short of an [USN:L1N44Y01V TEXT:"absolute majority"] in the state parliament, and it followed up two weeks later by taking first place in [USN:L1N45C01D TEXT:"Mecklenburg-Western Pomerania"].
The AfD has been accused by economists of fostering a climate that will drive away badly needed skilled workers and foreign investors.
The Left Party, meanwhile, vowed to tackle Berlin's soaring housing costs by [USN:L8N45D1DV TEXT:"expropriating the holdings"] of residential property companies.
"And whether it's Saxony-Anhalt with the AfD or what's happening here in Berlin, it's anything but conducive to economic growth. And it's anything but investment-friendly," Sewing said.
He urged the government of Chancellor Friedrich Merz to carry on with reforms to revive the economy.
"That is the only response we have to the far-right and far-left extremists in this country," he said.

NEW DELHI: Police detained hundreds of protesters in Delhi for a second day on Sunday (Oct 11) as sporadic protests broke out demanding India's election chief quit, and a court ordered the release of "cockroach" movement founder Abhijeet Dipke and two other senior leaders.
Dipke and the other Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) leaders were detained when their plane landed in Delhi on Saturday as the movement planned to gather thousands of people at Jantar Mantar in Central Delhi.
The court ordered their release with an undertaking to "maintain public peace", the CJP said in a statement.
"Cockroaches never die," the group posted on its X account shortly after Dipke's release.

Youth protesters, many of them from student organisations affiliated with India's communist parties, launched sporadic protests around the city on Sunday afternoon before police detained them and hauled them away in vehicles.
The All India Students' Association alleged in a post on X that those detained were assaulted by police inside the vehicles.

Ashutosh Ranka and Saurav Das of the Cockroach Janata Party (CJP) talk after their release at Delhi Cantt Police Station in New Delhi, India, Oct 11, 2026. (Photo: REUTERS/Priyanshu Singh)

A video posted on X by the Communist Party of India (Marxist) showed one of its lawmakers, John Brittas, being helped from a bus to an autorickshaw as he appeared to be in distress.
Reuters could not verify claims about detainees being assaulted by police.
The Delhi Police spokesperson did not respond to calls made by Reuters to seek comment.
The youth movement is one of the biggest political challenges to Prime Minister Narendra Modi in his 12 years in power, during which his Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) has repeatedly swept the polls and eliminated any serious challenge by opponents, including the Congress Party.
The protesters are calling for the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar over a revision of voter lists that critics say disproportionately benefits Modi.

items.title: Zelenski dice que Ucrania cesará ataques a refinerías si Rusia deja en paz su sistema de energía
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Ucrania está dispuesta a detener los ataques contra las refinerías de petróleo rusas si Moscú pone fin al bombardeo de la infraestructura energética ucraniana, dijo el domingo el presidente Volodímir Zelenski, después de que el presidente de Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, exigió a Kiev un cese unilateral.
items.body:
Ucrania está dispuesta a detener los ataques contra las refinerías de petróleo rusas si Moscú pone fin al bombardeo de la infraestructura energética ucraniana, dijo el domingo el presidente Volodímir Zelenski, después de que el presidente de Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, exigió a Kiev un cese unilateral.
Trump culpó el sábado a los ataques ucranianos contra las refinerías rusas del aumento de los precios del diésel en Estados Unidos y dijo que a Zelenski "más le vale dejar de hacerlo", además sostuvo que Ucrania debería sustituirlo como líder porque había desperdiciado varias oportunidades para llegar a un acuerdo con Moscú.
La fuerte subida de los precios mundiales del diésel, tras el estallido de la guerra de Irán en febrero, se ha convertido en un lastre político para el Partido Republicano de Trump antes de las elecciones legislativas del próximo mes, en las que los demócratas de la oposición podrían hacerse con el control de una o ambas cámaras del Congreso.
Zelenski reiteró el domingo la postura que Ucrania mantiene desde hace tiempo: que está dispuesta a detener los ataques contra las refinerías rusas únicamente como parte de una desescalada mutua del conflicto, lo que requeriría que Moscú cese sus propios ataques contra las infraestructuras energéticas ucranianas.
Cualquier acuerdo de este tipo tendría que ir acompañado de "garantías reales", dijo Zelenskiy.
"La verdadera causa de la guerra en Europa es Rusia y solo Rusia", dijo Zelenskiy, sin aludir específicamente a las declaraciones de Trump. "Es posible detener los ataques contra las infraestructuras energéticas ya desde hoy mismo, pero Putin no quiere hacerlo".
El sábado, Zelenski respondió airadamente al anuncio de Trump sobre un acuerdo de suministro de gasóleo con Rusia, que, según él, alentaría los ataques de Moscú contra Ucrania.
Analistas dijeron que es poco probable que el acuerdo de Trump con Moscú resulte en una baja sostenida de los precios del combustible, ya que los volúmenes siguen siendo muy inferiores a los que Rusia suele exportar cuando sus refinerías no están bajo ataque.
El acuerdo sobre el gasóleo también fue criticado por legisladores estadounidenses, entre ellos uno de los compañeros republicanos de Trump, el diputado Don Bacon, quien dijo que era el momento de aplicar más sanciones, no de levantarlas.
En las calles de Kiev, varios residentes expresaron su indignación ante la sugerencia de Trump de que Ucrania debería buscar un nuevo líder dispuesto a llegar a un acuerdo con el presidente ruso, Vladímir Putin.
"Nadie tiene derecho a decirnos qué hacer, sobre todo porque no se pueden tener elecciones en tiempo de guerra", dijo Sabina, una profesora de primaria de 40 años, refiriéndose a la prohibición de comicios en Ucrania bajo la ley marcial por razones de seguridad.
"En mi opinión, es una traición por parte de nuestros socios", añadió sobre las declaraciones de Trump.

WARSAW: Polish police have detained a man suspected of planning an attack on Prime Minister Donald Tusk, the Interior Minister said on Sunday (Oct 11), after it warned earlier of a threat to Tusk and Defence Minister Wladyslaw Kosiniak-Kamysz.
"The man who threatened and planned an attack on Prime Minister Donald Tusk has been detained by Polish police," Marcin Kierwinski wrote on X, without giving further details.
Tusk thanked the police for "swift and decisive action" in a separate post on X.
Polish security services earlier convened a special meeting after receiving information about a potential attack, a spokesperson said.

Special services spokesperson Jacek Dobrzynski said he could not go into details but authorities were treating the threat as "deadly serious".
"We are talking about a high probability of these threats being carried out," he told reporters.
Interior Ministry Spokesperson Karolina Galecka said an email with information about the potential attack had been forwarded to police by the State Protection Service, which is responsible for ministers' security.
While violent crime is relatively rare in Poland, the country is deeply polarised politically and has faced security threats due to its proximity to the war in Ukraine.
In August, police detained a 23-year-old man accused of calling for the assassination of senior Polish politicians.
In 2024, Tusk said he received threats after an assassination attempt on Slovak Prime Minister Robert Fico.

items.title: Mueren 109 migrantes, entre ellos 15 niños, en naufragio entre Yibuti a Yemen: agencia de la ONU
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Al menos 109 migrantes, entre ellos 15 niños, fallecieron y más de 116 están desaparecidos tras el naufragio de una embarcación que transportaba a unas 305 personas desde Yibuti a Yemen, informó el domingo la Organización Internacional para las Migraciones (OIM) de las Naciones Unidas.
items.body:
Al menos 109 migrantes, entre ellos 15 niños, fallecieron y más de 116 están desaparecidos tras el naufragio de una embarcación que transportaba a unas 305 personas desde Yibuti a Yemen, informó el domingo la Organización Internacional para las Migraciones (OIM) de las Naciones Unidas.
La embarcación zozobró cerca de Guhere, al norte de la ciudad portuaria yibutiana de Obock, durante la noche del 8 al 9 de octubre, según la OIM, que recabó testimonios de los supervivientes.
Más de 80 personas sobrevivieron al naufragio, todas ellas de nacionalidad etíope, según el comunicado. Un portavoz del Gobierno etíope no respondió de inmediato a las solicitudes de comentarios.
De los 109 cadáveres recuperados tras el naufragio, 52 son hombres, 42 mujeres y 15 niños, según la OIM.
"Nuestros equipos se encuentran sobre el terreno junto a las autoridades locales para prestar asistencia de emergencia", dijo Alexandre Coissac, jefe de misión de la OIM en Yibuti.
"Esta tragedia es un claro recordatorio de los peligros a los que se enfrentan los migrantes en este corredor migratorio en su búsqueda de oportunidades económicas", añadió Coissac.
Las autoridades de Yibuti continúan con las operaciones de búsqueda y rescate, según el comunicado de la OIM, que añadió que las autoridades locales también están prestando asistencia médica a los supervivientes y organizando los entierros de los fallecidos.
No fue posible contactar de inmediato con el Gobierno de Yibuti para recabar sus comentarios.
Yemen está viviendo la escalada más grave de los combates entre las fuerzas gubernamentales respaldadas por Arabia Saudita y los hutíes, apoyados por Irán, desde que una tregua negociada por la ONU detuvo en gran medida los ataques transfronterizos en 2022.
La reanudación del conflicto podría redefinir el control en Yemen, con repercusiones para las rutas marítimas del mar Rojo.
La OIM calificó de alarmante la crisis desencadenada por los combates, con cifras de desplazados que se han disparado de 76 000 a 200 000 desde mediados de septiembre, según datos publicados por la OIM la semana pasada.
Más de 3.700 personas han huido de Yemen por mar hacia Yibuti hasta la semana pasada, según la OIM.
El mes pasado también estallaron combates en Etiopía, en lo que supone la mayor escalada de violencia desde la guerra de Tigray.

items.title: Sheinbaum pide a poblaciones costeras de México refugiarse ante cercanía de huracán Simón
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: La presidenta de México, Claudia Sheinbaum, instó a los residentes de las poblaciones de la costa del Pacífico mexicano a permanecer bajo techo este domingo mientras el poderoso huracán Simón, de categoría 4, se acercaba a tierra, amenazando con vientos destructivos, peligrosas marejadas ciclónicas e inundaciones potencialmente mortales.
items.body:
La presidenta de México, Claudia Sheinbaum, instó a los residentes de las poblaciones de la costa del Pacífico mexicano a permanecer bajo techo este domingo mientras el poderoso huracán Simón, de categoría 4, se acercaba a tierra, amenazando con vientos destructivos, peligrosas marejadas ciclónicas e inundaciones potencialmente mortales.
Simón se encontraba a unos 105 km al oeste-noroeste de la ciudad portuaria Manzanillo, en el estado Colima, con vientos máximos sostenidos de 230 km/h, según informó el Centro Nacional de Huracanes (CNH) de Estados Unidos en su último boletín de las 9:00 hora local (1500 GMT).
El huracán se desplazaba hacia el nor-noroeste a 11 km/h, con su centro situado a unos 140 km al sur-sureste de Cabo Corrientes, en el vecino estado de Jalisco.
"Ante el próximo impacto del huracán Simón categoría 4, exhortamos a la población de municipios costeros de Jalisco, Colima, Nayarit y Michoacán a mantenerse en resguardo hasta el aviso oficial de que el peligro ha terminado", dijo Sheinbaum en una publicación en X.
La mandataria indicó que continuaban las evacuaciones preventivas hacia zonas más seguras y exhortó a la población a no salir a la calle y a seguir las instrucciones de Protección Civil.
El CNH informó que Simón podría tocar tierra entre Playa Perula y Cabo Corrientes en las próximas 12 a 18 horas, aunque un cambio en su trayectoria proyectada hacia el oeste planteaba la posibilidad de que el centro de la tormenta permaneciera en alta mar.
Incluso sin tocar tierra directamente, era probable que se registraran vientos catastróficos y marejadas ciclónicas que amenazaran vidas a lo largo de partes de la costa centro-occidental de México, advirtió la agencia.
Las autoridades mexicanas han declarado el nivel máximo de alerta en 28 municipios de Jalisco y Colima, mientras que otros 93 municipios se encuentran bajo alerta alta, según informes de medios locales.
El aeropuerto internacional de la localidad turística Puerto Vallarta ha cerrado temporalmente, al tiempo que las autoridades han suspendido actividades no esenciales y habilitado refugios de emergencia en las comunidades costeras amenazadas.
El CNH advirtió que las fuertes lluvias previstas hasta el lunes podrían provocar inundaciones y deslizamientos de tierra potencialmente mortales, especialmente en zonas montañosas.
Simón se intensificó rápidamente hasta convertirse en un huracán de categoría 4 el sábado, lo que llevó a las autoridades a desplegar personal militar, equipos de emergencia y brigadas de protección civil en las comunidades costeras vulnerables.
La tormenta llega una semana después de que el huracán Polo azotara la península de Baja California, en México, como huracán de categoría 2, derribando árboles y postes de tendido eléctrico e inundando calles.

items.title: Arsenal forward Russo voted as England women's player of the year
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Forward Alessia Russo has been voted by fans as England women's player of the year for the 2025-26 season, winning the award for the second time in her career, the national team announced on Sunday.
items.body:
Forward Alessia Russo has been voted by fans as England women's player of the year for the 2025-26 season, winning the award for the second time in her career, the national team announced on Sunday.
Arsenal player Russo, who also won the award in 2023-24, was the most prolific English scorer in the Women's Super League last season with 13 goals and six assists. Her double in a 3-0 win over Aston Villa in May helped Arsenal secure Champions League qualification.
The 27-year-old also played a leading role in England's World Cup qualification campaign, starting in all six group matches and scoring three times.
"To receive the award is really special, particularly as it comes directly from the fans," said Russo, who beat Lucy Bronze and Hannah Hampton in the poll.
"I absolutely love playing for England every moment I get... hopefully we will go on to have a really big season."
Russo was on the scoresheet when England beat Greece 3-1 in their World Cup round one playoff tie on Friday, with the reverse fixture set for Tuesday in Leicester.

items.title: Le pape Léon va être opéré d'un nodule au poumon
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Le pape Léon a déclaré dimanche que les médecins avaient détecté une petite excroissance pulmonaire lors d'un récent examen de santé et qu'il subirait une intervention chirurgicale cette semaine pour la retirer.
items.body:
Le pape Léon a déclaré dimanche que les médecins avaient détecté une petite excroissance pulmonaire lors d'un récent examen de santé et qu'il subirait une intervention chirurgicale cette semaine pour la retirer.
Âgé de 71 ans, Léon a déclaré aux pèlerins réunis sur la place Saint-Pierre à l'occasion de sa prière dominicale hebdomadaire que cette excroissance était circonscrite et avait été détectée à un stade précoce.
"Récemment, à l'occasion de certains examens, les médecins ont trouvé un nodule circonscrit au poumon. Il a été détecté à un stade très précoce et est bien localisé", a déclaré le souverain pontife.
"Les médecins estiment qu'il convient d'intervenir et, suivant leurs conseils, j'ai décidé de subir une intervention chirurgicale pour le retirer", a-t-il déclaré.
"Cette intervention est déjà programmée dans les prochains jours."
Le bureau de presse du Vatican a précisé que la convalescence du pape après l'opération devrait durer environ une semaine.
